literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒研究新进展:传播动态、免疫机制与临床挑战。
literature.lead_zh: 本周研究揭示了气候变化与城市化加剧登革热传播、B细胞受体依赖性增强感染的新机制、巴西DENV-3新谱系的快速扩散、以及重症登革热中意识障碍-ARDS-MODS三联征的高致死风险,同时强调了多模式诊断和疫苗评估框架的重要性。
key_findings_zh: 65%的纳入研究显示气温升高与登革热传播增加正相关,城市化与风险增加相关,传播向高地和城郊扩展[10.1371/journal.pntd.0013758]。
B细胞受体依赖性增强(BDE)是登革病毒感染的新机制,B细胞是急性期最大病毒储存库,补充了抗体依赖性增强模型[10.1128/jvi.02216-25]。
巴西DENV-3谱系III_B.3.2自2022年引入后快速扩散,其蛋白基序缺失可能促进复制优势,2025年DENV-3病例已超DENV-1[10.1007/s11262-026-02259-2]。
重症登革热ICU死亡三联征为意识障碍(RR 103.20)、ARDS(RR 7.55)和MODS(RR 6.08),血小板减少与死亡无关[10.7759/cureus.113041]。
TAK-003疫苗诱导多类非重叠体液免疫应答,除中和抗体外需纳入其他参数评估疫苗效果[10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.128929]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 登革热正加速向新地理区域(如伊朗、尼日利亚)和高海拔地区扩散,继发感染比例持续上升(阿根廷从31%升至53%),且与更严重临床表现相关。
literature.caveats_zh: 多数证据来自观察性研究或模型,因果推断有限;部分研究为单中心或病例报告,外推需谨慎。
literature.headline_en: Dengue virus research: transmission dynamics, immune mechanisms, and clinical challenges.
literature.lead_en: This week's findings reveal that climate change and urbanization intensify dengue transmission, a novel B cell receptor-dependent enhancement mechanism, rapid spread of a new DENV-3 lineage in Brazil, and a high-mortality triad of impaired consciousness-ARDS-MODS in severe dengue, while emphasizing multimodal diagnostics and comprehensive vaccine evaluation.
key_findings_en: 65% of 65 reviewed studies reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, with urbanization linked to higher risk and geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas [10.1371/journal.pntd.0013758].

B cell receptor-dependent enhancement (BDE) is a novel mechanism of dengue infection, with B cells as the largest reservoir of infected cells during acute dengue, complementing antibody-dependent enhancement [10.1128/jvi.02216-25].

DENV-3 lineage III_B.3.2, introduced in Brazil in 2022, rapidly spread with protein motif deletions potentially conferring replicative advantage; by December 2025, DENV-3 cases surpassed DENV-1 [10.1007/s11262-026-02259-2].
In severe dengue ICU patients, the mortality triad comprised impaired consciousness (RR 103.20), ARDS (RR 7.55), and MODS (RR 6.08); thrombocytopenia showed no mortality link [10.7759/cureus.113041].

TAK-003 vaccination elicited multiple non-overlapping humoral immune responses, supporting inclusion of parameters beyond neutralizing antibodies for vaccine evaluation [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.128929].
literature.trend_or_risk_en: Dengue is expanding into new regions (e.g., Iran, Nigeria) and high-altitude areas, with secondary infection proportions rising (from 31% to 53% in Argentina) and associated with more severe clinical outcomes.
literature.caveats_en: Most evidence comes from observational studies or models with limited causal inference; some studies are single-center or case reports, limiting generalizability.
literature.brief_en: Climate change and urbanization drive dengue expansion; B cell receptor-dependent enhancement is a new infection mechanism; a new DENV-3 lineage spreads rapidly in Brazil; impaired consciousness, ARDS, and MODS form a lethal triad in severe dengue; TAK-003 vaccine induces diverse immune responses.

news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: SPC 和 WHO 发布的多国情况报告详细介绍了太平洋地区的登革热 暴发。2025年,报告了12起暴发;2026年,新喀里多尼亚、汤加和瓦努阿图谢法省正式宣布暴发。库克群岛于 2026 年 5 月 25 日宣布其 暴发 结束。 [news-8056d1c0ff5aef37]
据 anewsofindia.com 报道,QDENGA 已成为印度首个获批的登革热 疫苗。批准状态在标题中显示为已确认的进展。 [news-c525c3b04693d488]
一项 2a 期、双盲、随机、安慰剂对照试验使用 DENV-3 对照人类感染模型评估了 mosnodenvir 作为 登革病毒 感染预防药物的 抗病毒药物 活性和安全性。 [news-65bcdf9ceeb0c31e]
中央药品标准控制组织 (CDSCO) 批准武田的 QDENGA (TAK-003) 疫苗,标志着印度第一个获得许可的登革热 疫苗,旨在预防所有四种 登革病毒 血清型。 [news-5ca8740b440b246c]

[news-8056d1c0ff5aef37]

papers.title: Unresolved questions in pediatric dengue: from disease mechanisms to prevention
papers.abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Despite recent advances in understanding dengue infection, substantial gaps remain in its epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention, including vaccine development and its long-term impact. This review summarizes recent findings and highlights the most pressing research needs to advance the field and reduce individual and public health burden. RECENT FINDINGS: Dengue burden has increased, particularly among children and adolescents, and it has expanded into previously unaffected regions. Still, current data likely underestimates the true burden due to suboptimal surveillance systems. Improving control will require a better understanding of severe dengue pathogenesis, where key gaps remain, alongside reassessment of diagnostic limitations in the context of increasing vaccine availability. Vaccines represent an important complementary tool, with several candidates under study and two currently in use, each with distinct strengths, limitations, and unresolved questions. SUMMARY: More extensive research and investment are needed to address the growing burden of dengue, including severe outbreaks and geographic spread. Meanwhile, stronger regulatory engagement in the development and evaluation of innovative therapeutic and preventive measures is essential, particularly in low-income and middle-income regions that bear the highest burden. Clear communication and education on dengue, its impact, and available preventive measures proven to be well tolerated and effective are also critical to strengthen trust, improve uptake, and maximize public health impact.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses unresolved questions in pediatric dengue, focusing on epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention. It highlights the increasing burden of dengue among children and adolescents, with expansion into new regions, though current data likely underestimates the true burden due to suboptimal surveillance. Key gaps remain in understanding severe dengue pathogenesis and diagnostic limitations amid growing vaccine availability. While vaccines represent an important complementary tool, unresolved questions persist regarding their strengths and limitations. The review emphasizes the need for more extensive research and investment, stronger regulatory engagement in innovative measures, particularly in high-burden regions, and clear communication to improve trust and uptake of preventive strategies.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述总结了最近的发现,并强调了紧迫的研究需求,但没有报告具体的数据库、检索日期、资格标准和研究数量。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 登革热负担有所增加,特别是在儿童和青少年中,并扩大到以前未受影响的地区;由于 监测 系统不理想,当前数据可能低估了真正的负担。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 重症登革热 发病机制、在增加 疫苗 可用性的背景下的诊断限制以及有关 疫苗 的优势、局限性和长期影响的未解决问题仍然存在关键差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要更广泛的研究和投资来解决登革热日益严重的负担,包括严重的 暴发 和地理传播;加强监管参与创新治疗和预防措施至关重要,特别是在低收入和中等收入地区;关于登革热的明确沟通和教育以及现有的预防措施对于加强信任和提高了解至关重要。

papers.title: Battling dengue in a warming world: How climate and urbanization shape transmission in low- and middle-income countries (a rapid review).
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.

This study aimed to synthesize how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This rapid systematic review followed a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982) and included 65 peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. The review focused on studies examining climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs.
analysis.methods: Six databases were searched, and study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively to evaluate the impact of specific environmental variables.
analysis.main_results: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, while 35% assessed urbanization, linking unplanned growth and inadequate infrastructure to increased risk. Studies also documented geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, seasonal shifts, and associations between urban heat islands and localized transmission hotspots.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. This review provides a recent synthesis of evidence linking these environmental drivers to expanded transmission ranges and prolonged seasons.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning within resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks. The findings highlight the need to integrate climate data into public health planning to address fragmented surveillance systems.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations or a detailed assessment of the strength of the evidence base. The review relied on narrative synthesis of studies with varying methodologies and quality assessments.

analysis.summary_en: This rapid systematic review synthesized evidence from 65 studies on how climate change and urbanization influence dengue transmission in low- and middle-income countries. The review found that 65% of studies reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased transmission, while urbanization factors such as unplanned growth and inadequate infrastructure were frequently linked to higher risk. Results indicated geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, seasonal shifts, and localized hotspots associated with urban heat islands. The authors concluded that these environmental factors are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed urban planning to mitigate future risks, though current efforts are often hindered by fragmented systems.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 给低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 带来了不成比例的负担,这些国家的 传播 模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响。本研究旨在综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项快速系统评价遵循注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982),包括 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的 65 项同行评审研究。该评价重点关注影响中低收入国家登革热 传播 的气候或城市化因素的研究。
elements_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,并使用用于实证研究的混合方法评估工具和用于建模研究的结构化评估来评估研究质量。对研究结果进行叙述性综合,以评估特定环境变量的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告气温升高与登革热 传播 增加之间呈正相关,而 35% 评估城市化,将计划外增长和基础设施不足与风险增加联系起来。研究还记录了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张、季节变化以及城市热岛和局部 传播 热点之间的关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。这篇综述提供了最新的证据综合,将这些环境驱动因素与 传播 范围扩大和季节延长联系起来。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 适应性应对措施需要在有弹性的城市基础设施内加强 监测 和气候知情规划,以减少未来的 监测 风险。研究结果强调需要将气候数据纳入公共卫生规划,以解决零散的 监测 系统问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制或证据基础强度的详细评估。该审查依赖于对不同方法和质量评估的研究进行叙述性综合。

papers.title_zh: 在变暖的世界中抗击登革热:气候和城市化如何影响低收入和中等收入国家的 传播(快速回顾)。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热 是一种全球流行的 媒介 传播疾病,低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 承受着不成比例的负担。传播 模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响,但最近没有综述综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。方法:我们按照注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982)进行了快速系统评价。检索了六个数据库(MEDLINE、Embase、Global Health、SciELO、Global Index Medicus 和 Web of Science),查找 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的同行评审研究。研究筛选了影响中低收入国家登革热 传播 的气候或城市化因素。研究质量使用混合方法评估工具进行实证研究和结构化评估进行建模研究。调查结果以叙述方式综合。结果:在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告称气温升高与登革热 传播 增加之间存在正相关关系,这通常归因于蚊子活动加剧和 传播 季节延长。35% 的研究对城市化进行了评估,无计划的增长、非正规住区和基础设施不足往往与风险增加相关。几项研究报告了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张,以及季节性变化,包括更早的发病和更长的 传播 时期。城市热岛和土地利用变化通常与局部 传播 热点相关。29% 的研究记录了政府的应对措施,尽管许多研究受到零散的 监测 系统、有限的跨部门协调或气候数据未充分纳入公共卫生规划的阻碍。结论:气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。适应性应对措施需要在弹性城市基础设施中加强 监测 和气候知情规划,以减少未来的 监测 风险。

analysis_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,并使用用于实证研究的混合方法评估工具和用于建模研究的结构化评估来评估研究质量。对研究结果进行叙述性综合,以评估特定环境变量的影响。

papers.title: Congenital Dengue Infection during the Epidemic in Argentina in the 2023-2024 Period: A Multicenter Registry.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe clinical, laboratory, and follow-up characteristics of neonates with confirmed dengue infection. STUDY DESIGN: Observational, descriptive, retrospective, and multicenter study including neonates with confirmed congenital dengue hospitalized at six centers from Argentina, between July 2023 and July 2024. Confirmation required virological or serological testing in both mother and neonate. Data were collected anonymously via REDCap and analyzed with RStudio. RESULTS: A total of 58 neonates were included. Most pregnant individuals presented with fever, myalgia, and headache. Maternal diagnosis was confirmed mainly by NS1 antigen (59%) and PCR (43%); 9% were serotyped, with 4⁄5 serotypes corresponding to DENV1. In all 52 pregnant individuals were hospitalized. Median gestational age at birth was 38 weeks, and 21% of neonates were preterm. Most deliveries were cesarean. At admission, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic; 26% showed respiratory distress or temperature instability. Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR in 59% of neonates. Two preterm neonates required mechanical ventilation. Median hospital stay was 9 days. Within the first week of life, 57% of neonates developed thrombocytopenia. No deaths or sequelae were recorded in neonates. One mother died because of severe dengue with shock. CONCLUSION: In this multicenter registry, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic and 21% preterm, with no deaths or sequelae at discharge and 30 days of follow-up. KEY POINTS: · In 98% of pregnant individuals with dengue infection was mild, and one died.. · About 74% of neonates with congenital dengue were asymptomatic.. · Thrombocytopenia was seen in 57% of neonates within the first week of life with a peak at day 7..

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项观察性、描述性、回顾性、多中心研究纳入了 2023 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月期间在阿根廷六个中心住院的 58 名确诊患有先天性登革热的新生儿,以及 52 名孕妇。
elements_zh.methods: 确诊感染需要对母亲和新生儿进行病毒学或血清学检测,其中母亲诊断主要通过NS1抗原(59%)和PCR(43%)进行检测,新生儿诊断在59%的病例中通过PCR确诊;数据通过 REDCap 匿名收集并使用 RStudio 进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数孕妇出现发烧、肌痛和头痛症状,98% 的人有轻度感染,但有 1 人因 重症登革热 休克死亡;21% 的新生儿早产,74% 入院时无症状,57% 在出生后第一周内出现血小板减少症,并在第 7 天达到高峰。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者对研究结果的解释是,大多数患有先天性登革热的新生儿没有症状,血小板减少症是常见现象,出院时和 30 天的随访中没有记录到新生儿死亡或后遗症。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调先天性登革热在新生儿中通常无症状,但具有血小板减少症的风险,为临床管理提供信息,同时也指出了严重孕产妇结局的可能性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于回顾性观察设计可能会受到选择和信息偏差的影响,证据强度中等,并且该研究依赖于现有的临床数据,没有对照组。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述确诊先天性登革热感染新生儿的临床、实验室和随访特征。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项观察性、描述性、回顾性、多中心研究纳入了 2023 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月期间在阿根廷六个中心住院的 58 名确诊患有先天性登革热的新生儿,以及 52 名孕妇。
analysis_zh.methods: 确诊感染需要对母亲和新生儿进行病毒学或血清学检测,其中母亲诊断主要通过NS1抗原(59%)和PCR(43%)进行检测,新生儿诊断在59%的病例中通过PCR确诊;数据通过 REDCap 匿名收集并使用 RStudio 进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 大多数孕妇出现发烧、肌痛和头痛症状,98% 的人有轻度感染,但有 1 人因 重症登革热 休克死亡;21% 的新生儿早产,74% 入院时无症状,57% 在出生后第一周内出现血小板减少症,并在第 7 天达到高峰。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者对研究结果的解释是,大多数患有先天性登革热的新生儿没有症状,血小板减少症是常见现象,出院时和 30 天的随访中没有记录到新生儿死亡或后遗症。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调先天性登革热在新生儿中通常无症状,但具有血小板减少症的风险,为临床管理提供信息,同时也指出了严重孕产妇结局的可能性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于回顾性观察设计可能会受到选择和信息偏差的影响,证据强度中等,并且该研究依赖于现有的临床数据,没有对照组。

papers.title: Molecular characterization and recent spread of dengue virus type 3 lineage III_B.3.2 in Brazil: in silico analysis of protein motifs and epidemiology
papers.abstract: Abstract The dengue virus (DENV) belongs to the Flaviviridae family and is responsible for a febrile arbovirus disease of global relevance. In Brazil, there has been endemic circulation of the four viral serotypes since the last century, with DENV-3 being frequently associated with more severe clinical conditions and major epidemics. This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology. We obtained cases information by serotype from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025. Furthermore, 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases were analyzed with the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2). The sequences were edited and analyzed with the MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs and were subsequently submitted to phylogenetic analyses in the IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. The results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but with a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases in 2024 compared to the previous year. By December 2025, DENV-3 cases had already surpassed those of DENV-1 for that year. Nine amino acid motifs were identified throughout the genome, especially sites of N-myristoylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation, protein kinase C phosphorylation, and N-glycosylation. The predominant lineages were 3III_C.2 and 3III_C.2.2 until 2022, when lineage 3III_B.3.2 was introduced in Brazil, being associated with the increase in cases. This genotype presented substitutions and the absence of protein motifs compared to previous lineages, suggesting that such alterations contributed to its replicative success.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus is a globally relevant febrile arbovirus disease, and in Brazil, DENV-3 has been frequently associated with severe clinical conditions and major epidemics. This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized case information by serotype obtained from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025 and analyzed 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases. The genomic analysis used the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2).
analysis.methods: Sequences were edited and analyzed with MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs, followed by phylogenetic analyses using IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. The study identified specific sites such as N-myristoylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation, protein kinase C phosphorylation, and N-glycosylation.
analysis.main_results: Results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases occurred in 2024 compared to the previous year. By December 2025, DENV-3 cases had surpassed those of DENV-1 for that year. Lineage 3III_B.3.2, introduced in 2022, presented substitutions and the absence of protein motifs compared to previous lineages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that the substitutions and absence of protein motifs in lineage 3III_B.3.2 contributed to its replicative success and association with the increase in cases. The shift from predominant lineages 3III_C.2 and 3III_C.2.2 to 3III_B.3.2 marks a recent change in the epidemiological landscape of DENV-3 in Brazil.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the importance of genomic surveillance to track the emergence and spread of specific DENV-3 lineages associated with rising case numbers. Understanding the molecular characteristics of successful lineages can inform risk assessment and public health responses to dengue outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations, sample size constraints, or potential biases in the data sources. The evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to the reliance on available database sequences and retrospective case data without detailed clinical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized the molecular motifs and epidemiology of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil using 184 complete genomes from GenBank and GISAID alongside national surveillance data from 2013 to 2025. Historically, DENV-1 was predominant, but DENV-3 cases surged in 2024 and surpassed DENV-1 by December 2025. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that lineage 3III_B.3.2, introduced in 2022, replaced previously dominant lineages and was associated with this increase. This lineage exhibited specific amino acid substitutions and the absence of certain protein motifs, which the authors suggest contributed to its replicative success. These findings underscore the value of genomic surveillance in monitoring evolving dengue threats and informing public health strategies.

This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study utilized case information by serotype obtained from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025 and analyzed 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases. The genomic analysis used the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2).
analysis_en.methods: Sequences were edited and analyzed with MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs, followed by phylogenetic analyses using IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. The study identified specific sites such as N-myristoylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation, protein kinase C phosphorylation, and N-glycosylation.
analysis_en.main_results: Results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases occurred in 2024 compared to the previous year. By December 2025, DENV-3 cases had surpassed those of DENV-1 for that year. analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that the substitutions and absence of protein motifs in lineage 3III_B.3.2 contributed to its replicative success and association with the increase in cases. analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the importance of genomic surveillance to track the emergence and spread of specific DENV-3 lineages associated with rising case numbers. Understanding the molecular characteristics of successful lineages can inform risk assessment and public health responses to dengue outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations, sample size constraints, or potential biases in the data sources. The evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to the reliance on available database sequences and retrospective case data without detailed clinical validation.

papers.title_zh: 登革病毒 3 型谱系 III_B.3.2 在巴西的分子特征和近期传播:蛋白质基序和 流行病学 的计算机分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The dengue virus (DENV) belongs to the Flaviviridae family and is responsible for a febrile arbovirus disease of global relevance. In Brazil, there has been endemic circulation of the four viral serotypes since the last century, with DENV-3 being frequently associated with more severe clinical conditions and major epidemics. This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology. We obtained cases information by serotype from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025. Furthermore, 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases were analyzed with the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2). The sequences were edited and analyzed with the MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs and were subsequently submitted to phylogenetic analyses in the IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. The results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but with a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases in 2024 compared to the previous year. By December 2025, DENV-3 cases had already surpassed those of DENV-1 for that year. Nine amino acid motifs were identified throughout the genome, especially sites of N-myristoylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation, protein kinase C phosphorylation, and N-glycosylation. The predominant lineages were 3III_C.2 and 3III_C.2.2 until 2022, when lineage 3III_B.3.2 was introduced in Brazil, being associated with the increase in cases. This genotype presented substitutions and the absence of protein motifs compared to previous lineages, suggesting that such alterations contributed to its replicative success.

papers.title: Molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of dengue virus infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The supplied evidence does not report specific study dates, centers, or sample sizes. The study utilized immortalized DENV-reactive B cells and live DENV to investigate infection mechanisms across all four serotypes.
analysis.methods: The study assessed the sensitivity of DENV infection to BCR and DENV envelope (E) protein interactions and characterized the entry process. Methods included determining the requirement for dynamin-mediated entry, proximal BCR signaling, and localization to late endosomes during viral infection of DENV-reactive B cells.
analysis.main_results: DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells was found to be highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. The entry process into this B cell subset is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors propose that BCR-dependent enhancement (BDE) provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings offer mechanistic insight into B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of DENV infection, which may explain the progression to severe dengue in some patients. analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific limitations regarding sample size, controls, or generalizability. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of dengue virus (DENV) infection to address the disconnect where B cells are the largest reservoir of infected cells during acute dengue despite the focus on antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Using immortalized DENV-reactive B cells and live DENV, researchers found that infection is highly sensitive to BCR and DENV envelope protein interactions. The entry process is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. The results demonstrate that these B cells support active viral replication of all four DENV serotypes. The authors propose that BDE complements ADE, offering a new mechanistic explanation for DENV immunopathogenesis and progression to severe disease.

papers.title: Beyond neutralization: A comprehensive framework for evaluating humoral immunity induced by a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Dengue incidence is increasing worldwide. TAK-003, a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine, is licensed in several countries. Its safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity have been extensively studied and provided the roadmap for recommendations and implementation. Per WHO guidelines, the primary immunogenicity endpoint in dengue vaccine clinical trials is neutralizing antibody (NAb) titers. However, there is no established immunological correlate of protection, and dengue virus (DENV) elicits a broad range of antibody responses. This study assessed statistical and experimental methods to evaluate a wide range of antibody responses to TAK-003 as a framework for evaluating vaccine immunological signatures that may correlate with protection from dengue infection and/or disease. METHODS: Responses were assessed by the following immunoassays: microneutralization assay, DENV total binding IgG ELISA, anti-dengue complement antibody assay, anti-dengue non-structural protein 1 (NS1) IgG ELISA, and anti-dengue IgG avidity assay. Samples from TAK-003 vaccinated/placebo participants from several trials were tested. Results were compared for assay performance and the impact of baseline serostatus, serotype, and age on vaccine-elicited responses. Correlation analyses assessed relationships among variables. Principal component analyses (PCA) evaluated data complexity. RESULTS: Vaccination elicited responses to all four DENV serotypes in each assay. The magnitude of vaccine-induced responses was higher in baseline seropositive participants, but vaccine effect was stronger in baseline seronegative participants. Baseline seronegative participants had comparable DENV total binding IgG concentrations, anti-dengue IgG avidity, and anti-dengue complement antibody titer responses across all serotypes. MNT50 NAb and anti-dengue NS1 IgG responses varied by serotype. Modest to low correlations across parameters suggest that the different assays measure non-redundant vaccine-induced humoral immune responses. The major source of response variability was post-vaccination time, followed by serotype. CONCLUSION: TAK-003 vaccination elicited multiple non-overlapping, unique humoral immune responses. Data support including parameters in addition to NAbs to better assess vaccine-induced humoral responses. CLINICALTRIALS: govregistration:NCT01511250, NCT02302066, NCT02747927, NCT03423173.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 发病率 在全球范围内不断增加,虽然 TAK-003(一种减毒活四价登革热 疫苗)已在多个国家获得许可,但尚未确定保护的免疫学相关性,并且 登革病毒 会引发广泛的抗体反应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了统计和实验方法,使用来自多项试验的疫苗接种者和安慰剂参与者的样本来评估对 TAK-003 的各种抗体反应。
elements_zh.methods: 通过微量中和测定、DENV 总结合 IgG ELISA、抗登革热补体抗体测定、抗登革热非结构蛋白 1 (NS1) IgG ELISA 和抗登革热 IgG 亲和力测定评估反应,比较测定性能以及基线血清状态、血清型和年龄对 疫苗 引发反应的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗接种 在每次测定中均引发对所有四种 DENV 血清型的反应,基线血清阳性参与者的反应幅度较高,但基线血清阴性参与者的 疫苗 效应更强;参数之间的中等至低相关性表明非冗余 疫苗 诱导的体液 免疫应答。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,TAK-003 疫苗接种 引发了多种非重叠、独特的体液 免疫应答,并且数据支持包括除了中和抗体之外的参数,以更好地评估 疫苗 诱导的体液反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为评估登革热 疫苗 诱导的体液免疫的综合框架的开发提供了信息,有可能改善对 疫苗 功效和保护的评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于具有不同设计的多个试验的观察数据,并且局限性包括潜在的混杂因素,例如 疫苗接种 后时间和血清型变异性。

Volume 32, Number 8—August 2026 Dispatch Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates Suggested citation for this article Abstract We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of <20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments. During the past few decades, mosquitoborne diseases have increased worldwide, partly because of the spread of competent mosquito vectors. Changes in climate are among the primary factors contributing to the expanded ranges of arbovirus vector mosquitoes into temperate zones (1). Meanwhile, arid regions with extremely hot summers, such as the Gulf countries of the Arabian Peninsula, were not colonized by invasive mosquitoes until recently, likely because of increased urbanization (2). Dengue fever is a mosquitoborne disease caused by dengue virus (DENV) and monitored through regional and international surveillance systems. Increased dengue activity, including autochthonous cases, was reported in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) after periods of increased rainfall in April 2024 (3). To monitor local mosquito species and identify circulating mosquitoborne viruses, we conducted a mosquito survey in Dubai, UAE. To investigate the spread and distribution pattern of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes in the city of Dubai, we initiated a targeted mosquito survey. We evaluated the trapped mosquitoes for the presence of mosquitoborne human pathogens by using molecular techniques. Mosquito trapping was part of an enhanced Dubai Municipality Public Health Services Department mosquito surveillance program. We started the entomologic survey on June 20, 2024, and continued it for 1 year. Our trapping method was opportunistic, designed to sample Ae. aegypti mosquitoes in urban areas, specifically targeting labor camps, construction sites, residential communities, and green spaces including parks, stables, ponds and lakes, and gardens. We placed BG-Sentinel mosquito traps (Biogents, https://us-shop.biogents.com) without a light source throughout the city of Dubai combined with CO2 lures. We conducted trapping over 3 days at 60 sites, each sampled 1–33 times (mean 4.3 times, median 2 times), with 1–7 sites (mean 1.9 sites, median 1 site)sampled per trapping period. We collected and transferred the trap contents to the Public Health Pest Control Section laboratory of Dubai Municipality. We identified Ae. aegypti and Anopheles stephensi mosquitoes morphologically (4; World Health Organization, https://iris.who.int/handle/10665/334210) and identified other mosquitoes to genus level. We pooled <20 mosquitoes per vial and froze the vials at –50°C. We homogenized mosquito pools in 500 μL of phosphate buffered saline with stainless steel beads (Benchmark Scientific, https://www.benchmarkscientific.com) on a Bead Mill homogenizer (OMNI International, https://www.fishersci.com). We extracted viral nucleic acid from mosquitoes by using a Quick-RNA Viral Kit (Zymo Research, https://www.zymoresearch.com) according to manufacturer instructions. We screened Ae. aegypti mosquitoes for dengue, chikungunya, Zika, yellow fever, Rift Valley fever, and Alkhurma hemorrhagic fever virus nucleic acids by using virus-specific quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR) kits (altona Diagnostics, https://altona-diagnostics.com). We retested and serotyped all samples positive for DENV by using the RealStar Dengue Type qRT-PCR Kit 1.0 (altona Diagnostics). We screened Culex spp., Aedes, and Ochlerotatus spp. mosquitoes for West Nile, Rift valley fever, and Alkhurma hemorragic fever virus nucleic acids by using the corresponding RealStar qRT-PCR Kits (altona Diagnostics). We also screened An. stephensi mosquitoes for Plasmodia parasites by using the RealStar Malaria Screen & Type PCR kit 1.0 (altona Diagnostics). We used a bias-corrected maximum likelihood estimate of minimum infection rate on the basis of variable size pooling with the package binGroup v2.2-1 in R version 4.3.3 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). We collected a total of 3,743 adult mosquitoes over 263 trapping periods: 1,598 Ae. aegypti, 1,555 Culex spp., 376 Ochlerotatus spp., and 214 An. stephensi. We found Ae. aegypti mosquitoes throughout Dubai, mainly collected from labor camps, construction sites, and green spaces. Compared with other mosquito species sampled, we found fewer An. stephensi mosquitoes in periurban areas with aquatic habitats (Figure 1). We observed seasonal variability in the number of mosquitoes collected, with the lowest number collected during the summer months (Figure 2). We detected DENV in 5 of 151 Ae. aegypti pools: 3 pools with DENV-1 and 2 with DENV-2. The field minimum infection rate was 3.1 (95% CI 0.4–5.9)/1,000 mosquitoes . We detected DENV-2 in the last week of June (epidemiologic week 26 of 2024) near the main Dubai airport (Figure 2). We detected both DENV-1 and DENV-2 from mid-November through mid-December (epidemiologic weeks 47–50 of 2024) in the southwest Al Hebiah 5 district (Figure 2). We did not detect any other viruses in the other mosquito pools, and we did not find Plasmodia parasites in any of the mosquito pools with An. stephensi mosquitoes. In most of the Gulf countries, the workforce is recruited from countries in which dengue, chikungunya, Zika, yellow fever, Rift Valley fever or West Nile virus are endemic, and imported cases were previously reported in the Arabian Peninsula. Dengue fever outbreaks in the Arabian Peninsula have occurred in Yemen and the Jeddah and Mecca region of Saudi Arabia (5). Oman, which borders UAE, experienced its first autochthonous dengue outbreak during December 2018 through mid-March 2019, with 59 reported cases (6). A second autochthonous outbreak occurred from mid-March through mid-April 2022 and involved 169 locally acquired cases (7). In the UAE, neither Aedes (Stegomyia) mosquitoes nor locally acquired dengue cases were reported in recent decades (5). Historically, there was evidence of Ae. aegypti mosquitoes in UAE as early as 1944 (8). However, it is assumed that the populations of Ae. aegypti mosquitoes from older records would not have survived the liberal use of insecticides in the second half of the 1900s (9). We did not find Ae. aegypti mosquitoes in our entomologic survey conducted during January–May 2018 in the UAE (10). The first recent record of an Ae. aegypti mosquito in Dubai was in May 2016, identified by the Public Health Pest Control Section laboratory, Dubai Municipality, and confirmed by the British Natural History Museum. Other Gulf countries such as Qatar also reported recent, yet sporadic, evidence of Ae. aegypti mosquitoes (11). Regional and global species distribution models have indicated that urban areas in Gulf countries are suitable for Ae. aegypti mosquitoes (12). Likely, the increased DENV activity we observed was driven by a recently established Ae. aegypti population in Dubai. In recent years, increased frequency of heavy rainfall with flooding and stagnant surface water were recorded worldwide including the Gulf countries, contributing to an increase in mosquito abundance and dengue cases (13). In addition, manmade water-containing vessels can serve as reservoirs for immature Ae. aegypti mosquitoes and correlate with cases of dengue fever (14). Those sources of water in arid environments likely contribute to extended mosquito survival during dry periods (15). Our results demonstrate the widespread distribution of Ae. aegypti mosquitoes in Dubai. We detected DENV-1 and DENV-2 in Ae. aegypti mosquitoes from 2 sampling locations within the urban area of Dubai, which coincided with a DENV-2 outbreak in humans (Dubai Health, unpub. data). Our findings demonstrate the value of integrated entomologic and molecular surveillance for early detection of mosquitoborne pathogens in arid urban settings. Future studies should establish seasonality and habitat associations to assist with mosquito control. The presence of Ae. aegypti mosquitos in urban areas in the Gulf region necessitates steps to reduce or eliminate DENV transmission. Efforts should include educating the public on avoiding mosquitoes, surveillance and targeted mosquito control, and isolating infected individuals quickly to prevent spread. Dr. Nowotny is professor of virology at the University of Veterinary Medicine, Vienna, Austria, and visiting professor at the College of Medicine, Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences, Dubai Health, Dubai, UAE. His research interests include emerging, zoonotic, and mosquitoborne virus infections. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 据报告,2024 年 4 月降雨量增加后,阿拉伯联合酋长国的登革热活动有所增加,包括本土病例。为了监测当地蚊子种类并识别传播的蚊媒病毒,我们在阿联酋迪拜进行了蚊子调查。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们于2024年6月20日开始,在阿拉伯联合酋长国迪拜进行了为期1年的蚊虫调查。我们使用结合了CO2诱饵的BG-Sentinel蚊虫陷阱进行机会性诱捕,采集了1,598只埃及伊蚊。该调查针对的城市区域包括劳工营地、建筑工地、住宅社区和绿地。
elements_zh.methods: 我们利用分子技术评估了被捕获的蚊子是否存在蚊媒人类病原体。诱捕蚊子是迪拜市公共卫生服务部蚊子 监测 计划的一部分。我们在 5 个池中检测到 登革病毒,蚊子数量少于 20 只。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们收集了 1,598 只埃及伊蚊,并在 5 个池中检测到了 登革病毒,其中蚊子数量少于 20 只。提供的证据没有报告具体的感染率、血清型分布或统计比较。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果强调了持续的 媒介 监测 对于 登革病毒 在干旱城市环境中的重要性。在埃及伊蚊中检测到 登革病毒 证实了继 2024 年 暴发 后当地 传播 的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了需要持续实施 媒介 监测 来管理迪拜等干旱城市环境中的 登革病毒 风险。公共卫生工作应重点监测劳改营、建筑工地和绿地的蚊子数量,以预防未来的 暴发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的研究局限性或证据强度的详细评估。机会主义捕获方法可能会限制研究结果对迪拜所有城市地区的推广。

papers.title: Dengue fever outbreak in Iran: Urgent warnings and solutions
papers.abstract: Following the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue fever, one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases, has become a serious public health challenge in many countries around the world in recent years.Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions.Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate.Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country's health system.Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action.Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public.By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

papers.abstract_zh: 自COVID-19大流行以来,最重要的蚊媒病毒性疾病之一登革热近年来已成为全球许多国家面临的严重公共卫生挑战。这种疾病由埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊传播,在热带和亚热带地区流行。伊朗尽管地处干旱和半干旱气候地区,但也面临传播这种疾病的风险。最近有当地病例报告霍尔木兹甘省,特别是伦盖市的登革热为该国的卫生系统敲响了警钟。登革热是伊朗公共卫生面临的一个新威胁,需要采取紧急和协调的行动。控制这种疾病需要社会各界的参与,包括政府、卫生机构和公众。通过实施科学和可持续的战略并与政府机构协调,可以防止伊朗成为该病的流行地区。登革热。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管登革热在热带和亚热带地区存在,但登革热已成为包括伊朗在内的许多国家的严重公共卫生挑战。该研究强调迫切需要采取协调行动,以防止伊朗成为 登革热 的流行区。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注霍尔木兹甘省的 登革热 暴发,特别是伊朗境内的班达尔伦盖市 (Bandar Lengeh)。它报告了最近的当地病例,为该国的卫生系统敲响了警钟。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究没有提供数据收集或分析的详细方法或程序。它依赖于报告的病例和 暴发 的一般观察。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究报告了霍尔木兹甘省最近发生的 登革热 当地病例,特别是在班达尔伦盖市,这表明伊朗的公共卫生面临新的威胁。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将最近的当地病例解读为对伊朗卫生系统的重大警告,强调需要采取紧急和协调行动,以防止该疾病流行。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在伊朗实施科学和可持续战略来控制 登革热 的重要性,特别是在霍尔木兹甘省等已报告当地 传播 的地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有提供详细的方法或统计分析,这限制了其研究结果的可信度。然而,证据是基于最近的当地案例,这些案例被明确报告并支持新出现威胁的结论。

papers.title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis and Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Despite Negative PCR.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite an initial negative PCR result. The diagnosis was confirmed through serological testing (positive NS1 and IgM antibodies) and abdominal imaging. The patient developed severe symptoms, including fever, splenomegaly, and laboratory abnormalities, but was managed conservatively and fully recovered without invasive procedures or immunosuppressive therapy. The study emphasizes the need for multimodal diagnostic testing in dengue fever due to potential false-negative PCR results and demonstrates that severe complications can resolve with supportive care alone.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 报告一例 登革热 并发急性非结石性胆囊炎 (AAC) 和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症 (HLH),尽管最初的聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 结果呈阴性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们描述了一名 40 岁女性的临床病程,她从印度尼西亚返回,出现持续发烧和皮疹。
elements_zh.methods: 诊断是通过临床评估、血清学检测和腹部影像学建立的。该研究符合《赫尔辛基宣言》中概述的原则。
elements_zh.main_results: 虽然最初的登革热PCR结果呈阴性,但随后的NS1和IgM抗体检测结果呈阳性。患者出现了严重的并发症,包括以胆囊壁增厚为特征的 AAC 和以明显发热、脾肿大、低纤维蛋白原血症、高铁蛋白血症和高可溶性 IL-2 受体水平为特征的 HLH。尽管有这些症状,患者仍经过保守治疗,在未输注皮质类固醇或血小板的情况下完全康复,并于第 14 天出院。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 鉴于登革热急性期 PCR 结果可能出现假阴性,多模式血清学检测至关重要。该病例表明,严重的非典型并发症,如 AAC 和 HLH,可以仅通过支持性护理来解决,避免侵入性手术、免疫抑制治疗和血小板输注。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了 登革热 综合诊断方法的重要性,特别是当 PCR 结果为阴性时,并支持对严重并发症的保守治疗,以避免不必要的干预。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于单个 病例报告,限制了普遍性。然而,详细的临床过程和多模式诊断方法为报告的结果和管理策略提供了适度的信心。

papers.title: Impaired Consciousness, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS), and Multiorgan Dysfunction Syndrome (MODS) As the Triad of Mortality in Severe Dengue: Evidence From 100 Consecutive ICU Admissions
papers.abstract: Background Severe dengue is a leading contributor to intensive care unit (ICU) admissions and death in tropical regions. Identifying factors associated with poor outcomes early is critical for guiding treatment and allocating resources in critically ill patients. Methods This prospective observational cohort enrolled 100 consecutive patients with WHO 2009-defined severe dengue admitted to the ICU and Emergency Department of Maharishi Markandeshwar Institute of Medical Science and Research (MMIMSR), Mullana, Haryana, between March 2025 and January 2026. Clinical, laboratory, and severity-score data (Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II), Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA)) were recorded and compared between survivors and non-survivors using appropriate statistical tests, relative risks (RR) with 95% CI, and ROC analysis. Results The mean age was 47.2 ± 17.5 years; 58% were male. ICU mortality was 21.0% (21/100). Thrombocytopenia showed no mortality link (p = 0.678). Higher pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, total leucocyte count, creatinine, bilirubin, and lactate, together with lower blood pressure, Glasgow Coma scale (GCS) score, arterial pH, and PaO2, were each associated with ICU mortality (all p 2 cm was significant (50.0% vs. 17.0% mortality; RR 2.93, 95% CI 1.41-6.09; p = 0.024). Impaired consciousness (72.4% vs. 0% mortality; RR 103.20, 95% CI 6.46-1649.18; p < 0.001), acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS; 100% vs. 12.2%; RR 7.55, 95% CI 4.33-13.16; p < 0.001), and multiorgan dysfunction syndrome (MODS; 76.9% vs. 12.6%; RR 6.08, 95% CI 3.25-11.39; p = 0.002) showed the strongest associations (φ = 0.807, 0.647, 0.531 respectively). APACHE II (AUC 0.935) and SOFA (AUC 0.938) had the best discriminative accuracy, followed by lactate (AUC 0.835) and arterial pH (AUC 0.824). Conclusions Impaired consciousness, ARDS, and MODS strongly predicted mortality in this severe dengue cohort, forming a clinically vital cluster for early risk stratification. These single-center findings question the thrombocytopenia-centric paradigm and support closer attention to neurological status and organ dysfunction from ICU admission onward.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational cohort study analyzed 100 consecutive patients with severe dengue admitted to an ICU in India between March 2025 and January 2026 to identify factors associated with mortality. The overall ICU mortality rate was 21.0%, and thrombocytopenia was not linked to mortality. papers.title_zh: 重症登革热 中意识障碍、急性呼吸窘迫综合征 (ARDS) 和多器官功能障碍综合征 (MODS) 作为 死亡率 的三联征:来自 100 例连续 ICU 入院的证据
papers.source_body_en: Background Severe dengue is a leading contributor to intensive care unit (ICU) admissions and death in tropical regions. Identifying factors associated with poor outcomes early is critical for guiding treatment and allocating resources in critically ill patients. Methods This prospective observational cohort enrolled 100 consecutive patients with WHO 2009-defined severe dengue admitted to the ICU and Emergency Department of Maharishi Markandeshwar Institute of Medical Science and Research (MMIMSR), Mullana, Haryana, between March 2025 and January 2026. Clinical, laboratory, and severity-score data (Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II), Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA)) were recorded and compared between survivors and non-survivors using appropriate statistical tests, relative risks (RR) with 95% CI, and ROC analysis. Results The mean age was 47.2 ± 17.5 years; 58% were male. ICU mortality was 21.0% (21/100). Thrombocytopenia showed no mortality link (p = 0.678). Higher pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, total leucocyte count, creatinine, bilirubin, and lactate, together with lower blood pressure, Glasgow Coma scale (GCS) score, arterial pH, and PaO2, were each associated with ICU mortality (all p 2 cm was significant (50.0% vs. 17.0% mortality; RR 2.93, 95% CI 1.41-6.09; p = 0.024). Impaired consciousness (72.4% vs. 0% mortality; RR 103.20, 95% CI 6.46-1649.18; p < 0.001), acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS; 100% vs. 12.2%; RR 7.55, 95% CI 4.33-13.16; p < 0.001), and multiorgan dysfunction syndrome (MODS; 76.9% vs. 12.6%; RR 6.08, 95% CI 3.25-11.39; p = 0.002) showed the strongest associations (φ = 0.807, 0.647, 0.531 respectively). APACHE II (AUC 0.935) and SOFA (AUC 0.938) had the best discriminative accuracy, followed by lactate (AUC 0.835) and arterial pH (AUC 0.824). Conclusions Impaired consciousness, ARDS, and MODS strongly predicted mortality in this severe dengue cohort, forming a clinically vital cluster for early risk stratification. These single-center findings question the thrombocytopenia-centric paradigm and support closer attention to neurological status and organ dysfunction from ICU admission onward.

papers.title: Deep learning with LSTM networks for dengue disease forecasting and control
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate forecasting of infectious disease dynamics is essential for effective public health planning and early outbreak response. Traditional statistical models and modern deep learning approaches have both been widely used for epidemiological time–series forecasting. Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where seasonal outbreaks often produce sharp and unpredictable infection spikes. Reliable forecasting models are therefore important for anticipating infection trends and supporting early intervention strategies. This study investigates the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for predicting daily dengue infection counts in Bangladesh using surveillance data from 2010 to 2022. Multiple LSTM architectures were developed by varying the number of LSTM units, lookback window size, and data preprocessing strategies. A fixed time-based data split was used, with training data up to 30 September 2021 and testing on subsequent observations to avoid information leakage. The proposed LSTM models were compared with several baseline forecasting approaches, including Naive, Seasonal-Naive, and ARIMA models. Model performance was evaluated using standard forecasting metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE). Experimental results indicate that classical statistical models remain strong benchmarks for dengue forecasting. Among all evaluated models, the ARIMA(2,1,2) model achieved the best predictive performance on the test dataset with MAE of 8.40 and RMSE of 14.72. The best-performing LSTM configuration produced competitive results with MAE of 8.92 and RMSE of 15.87, outperforming simple baseline approaches such as the Naive and Seasonal-Naive models. These findings suggest that while deep learning models are capable of capturing complex temporal patterns, their advantage over well-tuned statistical models is not guaranteed for this dataset. The results highlight the importance of benchmarking deep learning models against classical time-series approaches when forecasting epidemiological data. While LSTM networks demonstrate promising performance in modeling nonlinear temporal dynamics, the ARIMA model provided the most accurate predictions for the studied dengue dataset.

papers.title_zh: 使用 LSTM 网络进行深度学习用于登革热疾病预测和控制
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Accurate forecasting of infectious disease dynamics is essential for effective public health planning and early outbreak response. Traditional statistical models and modern deep learning approaches have both been widely used for epidemiological time–series forecasting. Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where seasonal outbreaks often produce sharp and unpredictable infection spikes. Reliable forecasting models are therefore important for anticipating infection trends and supporting early intervention strategies. This study investigates the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for predicting daily dengue infection counts in Bangladesh using surveillance data from 2010 to 2022. Multiple LSTM architectures were developed by varying the number of LSTM units, lookback window size, and data preprocessing strategies. A fixed time-based data split was used, with training data up to 30 September 2021 and testing on subsequent observations to avoid information leakage. The proposed LSTM models were compared with several baseline forecasting approaches, including Naive, Seasonal-Naive, and ARIMA models. Model performance was evaluated using standard forecasting metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE). Experimental results indicate that classical statistical models remain strong benchmarks for dengue forecasting. Among all evaluated models, the ARIMA(2,1,2) model achieved the best predictive performance on the test dataset with MAE of 8.40 and RMSE of 14.72. The best-performing LSTM configuration produced competitive results with MAE of 8.92 and RMSE of 15.87, outperforming simple baseline approaches such as the Naive and Seasonal-Naive models. These findings suggest that while deep learning models are capable of capturing complex temporal patterns, their advantage over well-tuned statistical models is not guaranteed for this dataset. The results highlight the importance of benchmarking deep learning models against classical time-series approaches when forecasting epidemiological data. While LSTM networks demonstrate promising performance in modeling nonlinear temporal dynamics, the ARIMA model provided the most accurate predictions for the studied dengue dataset.

papers.title: Clinical Profile and Treatment Patterns of Dengue Patients Admitted to a Tertiary Care Hospital in Bangladesh: a Hospital-Based Observational Study
papers.abstract: In Bangladesh, dengue is a serious public health issue that spreads quickly through mosquitoes and usually necessitates hospitalization for supportive care. The purpose of this hospital-based observational study was to assess the clinical presentation, treatment methods, hospitalization trends and sociodemographic profile of 205 dengue patients who were admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka. Young adults, aged 21 to 30 years, accounted for the highest percentage of cases, indicating their significant affliction. Dengue hemorrhagic fever (10.24%) and dengue shock syndrome (2.93%) were the next most common causes of hospitalization, after dengue fever (86.82%). Patients from outside of Dhaka constituted a larger percentage of severe cases and had longer hospital stays; part of the variation in hospitalization duration was explained by demographic characteristics (R2 = 0.2505). High fever (82.93%), nausea and vomiting (45.37%), headache (40%), bleeding (21.95%), and shock (8.78%) were the most frequent clinical symptoms. The mainstay of treatment was fluid therapy, with 45.36% of patients receiving normal saline along with dextrose preparations and 32.68% receiving 5% DNS. When clinically necessary, antihistamines, antibiotics and antiemetics were taken in addition to paracetamol (82.93%), multivitamin supplements (90.73%) and Carica papaya leaf extract (75.6%). To enhance outcomes and direct dengue control methods in Bangladesh, the data from this research highlights current hospitalization trends and stresses the significance of prompt, supportive care in the clinical management of dengue cases. Bangladesh Pharmaceutical Journal 29(2): 215-227, 2026 (July)

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue poses a serious public health burden in Bangladesh, often requiring hospitalization for supportive care, yet detailed clinical and treatment data remain limited. This study aimed to characterize the clinical presentation, treatment patterns, and sociodemographic profile of hospitalized dengue patients to inform local management and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A hospital-based observational study was conducted at a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka, Bangladesh, enrolling 205 laboratory-confirmed dengue patients admitted during the study period. The study described sociodemographic characteristics, clinical features, and hospitalization trends among these patients.
analysis.methods: The study retrospectively analyzed medical records to extract demographic data, clinical symptoms, disease severity classifications, and treatment regimens. Hospitalization duration was modeled against demographic variables using linear regression (R2 = 0.2505) to assess factors influencing length of stay.
analysis.main_results: Among 205 patients, dengue fever accounted for 86.82%, dengue hemorrhagic fever for 10.24%, and dengue shock syndrome for 2.93%. The most frequent symptoms were high fever (82.93%), nausea and vomiting (45.37%), headache (40%), bleeding (21.95%), and shock (8.78%). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the predominance of young adults among hospitalized cases and underscores the importance of prompt supportive care, particularly fluid resuscitation, in managing dengue. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform hospital-based dengue management protocols, prioritize resource allocation for severe cases, and support targeted public health interventions to reduce hospitalization burden in Bangladesh.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a single-center, retrospective observational study, the findings may not be generalizable to other settings and are subject to selection and information biases. analysis.summary_en: This hospital-based observational study in Dhaka, Bangladesh, analyzed 205 dengue patients to characterize clinical presentations, treatment patterns, and sociodemographic profiles. Dengue fever was the most common diagnosis (86.82%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (10.24%) and dengue shock syndrome (2.93%). Limitations include single-center design, retrospective data collection, and modest explanatory power of demographic factors for hospitalization duration.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热在孟加拉国造成严重的公共卫生负担,通常需要住院接受支持性护理,但详细的临床和 治疗 数据仍然有限。本研究旨在描述住院登革热患者的临床表现、治疗 模式和社会人口学特征,为当地管理和控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 孟加拉国达卡的一家三级护理医院进行了一项以医院为基础的观察性研究,招募了研究期间入院的 205 名实验室确诊的登革热患者。该研究描述了这些患者的社会人口学特征、临床特征和住院趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究回顾性分析了医疗记录,以提取人口统计数据、临床症状、疾病严重程度分类和 治疗 方案。使用线性回归(R2 = 0.2505)根据人口变量对住院时间进行建模,以评估影响住院时间的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 205例患者中,登革热占86.82%,登革出血热占10.24%,登革休克综合征占2.93%。最常见的症状是高烧(82.93%)、恶心呕吐(45.37%)、头痛(40%)、出血(21.95%)和休克(8.78%)。液体疗法是主要疗法,45.36% 的患者接受生理盐水加葡萄糖,32.68% 的患者接受 5% DNS。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了住院病例中年轻人的主导地位,并强调了及时支持治疗(特别是液体复苏)在管理登革热方面的重要性。它提供了有关临床概况和 治疗 模式的当地相关数据,可以指导孟加拉国的登革热控制工作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基于医院的登革热管理方案提供信息,优先分配重症病例的资源,并支持有针对性的公共卫生干预措施,以减轻孟加拉国的住院负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项单中心、回顾性观察研究,研究结果可能无法推广到其他环境,并且会受到选择和信息偏差的影响。回归模型的中等解释力(R2 = 0.2505)进一步限制了因果推断,需要谨慎解释。

papers.title: A Dendrimer-Based Multiple Antigenic Peptide (MAP) Approach for Dengue Vaccine Development: In Silico and In Vivo Insights on Safety and Effectiveness
papers.abstract: Dengue fever, a rapidly spreading mosquito-borne viral disease, poses a major global health issue, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. The absence of a universally effective vaccine against all four dengue virus serotypes necessitates continued exploration of novel vaccine strategies. This study evaluated a PrM-derived multiple antigenic peptide (MAP) vaccine candidate in BALB/c mice. Molecular docking analyses predicted favourable interactions of the selected PrM-derived B-cell epitope with both human (human BCR Fab region PDB ID: 5IFH) and mouse (mouse BCR PDB ID: 8EMA) B-cell receptors, supporting its antigenic potential. ChemSketch was used to develop the PrM–MAP vaccine construct, which was then commercially synthesized. Mice received single, double, and triple booster doses of the vaccine, while control groups received either PBS or adjuvant alone. Humoral immune responses were measured by ELISA, and safety was evaluated through in vitro cytotoxicity assays on HEK293 cells and the in vivo histopathological examination of major organs. Mice immunized with a single booster dose produced significant levels of PrM-specific antibodies compared to subsequent booster doses, suggesting variability in the humoral response elicited. Optimal coating concentrations in ELISA demonstrated the importance of antigen concentrations in the sensitivity of the assay. The safety evaluation indicated high cell viability, up to 150 μg/mL of PrM–MAP, in HEK293 cells, and an absence of significant histopathological damage in treated animals. The PrM–MAP vaccine construct elicited a detectable humoral immune response while demonstrating a high safety profile in vitro and in vivo. These findings indicate the potential of MAP-based vaccine platforms as promising candidates for further development against the dengue virus.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Dengue Risk in Bangladesh: A GIS Based Approach.
papers.abstract: Dengue, commonly known as breakbone fever, has been prevalent in Bangladesh since 2000. Monsoon conditions and warmer temperatures create suitable breeding environment for the vectors Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Although dengue outbreaks peak during the post-monsoon months (September and October), 2023 showed an unusual shift, with cases peaking as early as June. The case fatality rate (0.54%) in 2023 was the highest in the past two decades. This study offers an exhaustive examination of the spatiotemporal dynamics of dengue incidence clusters and composite risk across Bangladesh using daily dengue case data from 2019 to 2024. Spatial autocorrelation analysis (Local Moran's I) revealed that the central and south coastal districts, especially Dhaka, Manikganj, and Barisal were the major dengue hotspots during the peak outbreak years (2019, 2023, and 2024). Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI) analysis further indicated strong seasonal and interannual reorganization of dengue hotspots, especially during the post-monsoon season, with increasing hotspot concentration in coastal districts after 2020. To assess hazard, vulnerability and risk, we applied a GIS-based multi-criteria decision-making model (MCDM) framework and compared both weighted (AHP-based) and unweighted approaches. The weighted AHP model was more accurate (AUC = 0.75) than the unweighted model (AUC = 0.55) in predicting dengue risk zones. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression showed that lagged temperature, precipitation and population density increased dengue incidence, while higher normalized difference built-up index was associated with lower incidence. These findings emphasize the need for integrated dengue control strategies targeting high-risk areas and equal healthcare access.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue has been prevalent in Bangladesh since 2000, and this study aimed to examine the spatiotemporal dynamics of dengue incidence clusters and composite risk across the country.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used daily dengue case data from 2019 to 2024 across Bangladesh to analyze spatiotemporal dynamics and risk factors.
analysis_en.methods: Spatial autocorrelation analysis (Local Moran's I), Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI), a GIS-based multi-criteria decision-making model (MCDM), and a negative binomial mixed-effects regression were applied to assess dengue risk and associated factors.
analysis_en.main_results: Dengue outbreaks peaked in September and October, but in 2023, cases peaked as early as June; the case fatality rate in 2023 was 0.54%, the highest in two decades; central and south coastal districts, especially Dhaka, Manikganj, and Barisal, were major hotspots; the weighted AHP model (AUC = 0.75) was more accurate than the unweighted model (AUC = 0.55) in predicting risk zones.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight unusual shifts in dengue outbreaks and increasing hotspot concentration in coastal districts after 2020, emphasizing the need for targeted control strategies.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights for integrated dengue control strategies targeting high-risk areas and ensuring equal healthcare access.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on observational data and models, though the comprehensive spatiotemporal analysis and validated models support robust conclusions.

papers.title_zh: 孟加拉国登革热风险的时空动态:基于 GIS 的方法。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue, commonly known as breakbone fever, has been prevalent in Bangladesh since 2000. Monsoon conditions and warmer temperatures create suitable breeding environment for the vectors Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Although dengue outbreaks peak during the post-monsoon months (September and October), 2023 showed an unusual shift, with cases peaking as early as June. The case fatality rate (0.54%) in 2023 was the highest in the past two decades. This study offers an exhaustive examination of the spatiotemporal dynamics of dengue incidence clusters and composite risk across Bangladesh using daily dengue case data from 2019 to 2024. Spatial autocorrelation analysis (Local Moran's I) revealed that the central and south coastal districts, especially Dhaka, Manikganj, and Barisal were the major dengue hotspots during the peak outbreak years (2019, 2023, and 2024). Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI) analysis further indicated strong seasonal and interannual reorganization of dengue hotspots, especially during the post-monsoon season, with increasing hotspot concentration in coastal districts after 2020. To assess hazard, vulnerability and risk, we applied a GIS-based multi-criteria decision-making model (MCDM) framework and compared both weighted (AHP-based) and unweighted approaches. The weighted AHP model was more accurate (AUC = 0.75) than the unweighted model (AUC = 0.55) in predicting dengue risk zones. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression showed that lagged temperature, precipitation and population density increased dengue incidence, while higher normalized difference built-up index was associated with lower incidence. These findings emphasize the need for integrated dengue control strategies targeting high-risk areas and equal healthcare access.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热俗称断骨热,自2000年以来在孟加拉国流行。季风条件和温暖的气温为媒介埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊创造了适宜的繁殖环境。尽管登革热 暴发 在季风后几个月(9 月和 10 月)达到峰值,但 2023 年出现了不寻常的转变,病例最早在 6 月达到峰值。2023年的病死率(0.54%)是过去二十年来最高的。本研究使用 2019 年至 2024 年的每日登革热病例数据,对整个孟加拉国的登革热 发病率 集群的时空动态和复合风险进行了详尽的检查。空间自相关分析(Local Moran's I)显示,中部和南部沿海地区,特别是达卡、马尼克甘杰和巴里萨尔是 暴发 高峰年(2019 年,2019 年)的主要登革热热点地区。2023 年和 2024 年)。杰卡德相似指数 (JSI) 分析进一步表明,登革热热点存在强烈的季节性和年际重组,特别是在季风后季节,2020 年之后沿海地区的热点集中度不断增加。为了评估危害、脆弱性和风险,我们应用了基于 GIS 的多标准决策模型 (MCDM) 框架,并比较了加权(基于 AHP)和未加权方法。在预测登革热风险区方面,加权 AHP 模型 (AUC = 0.75) 比未加权模型 (AUC = 0.55) 更准确。负二项混合效应回归显示,滞后的温度、降水和人口密度增加了登革热 发病率,而较高的归一化差异累积指数与较低的 发病率 相关。这些发现强调需要针对高风险地区和平等的医疗保健机会制定综合登革热控制策略。

papers.title: Shared evidence, different recommendations: a comparative analysis of Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue is an increasingly important cause of illness in travellers, and Qdenga (TAK-003) is the first dengue vaccine incorporated into guidance for travellers in multiple countries. However, clinicians and travellers may encounter differing recommendations across jurisdictions. This study compared guidance on the use of Qdenga in travellers across countries. Methods We conducted a comparative analysis of national guidance on Qdenga use for travellers across countries, using survey data and structured review of publicly available recommendations. Guidance was synthesised according to dengue immune status and mapped across recurring decision domains. Results Survey responses were obtained from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries between March and April 2026, including twelve non-endemic countries where Qdenga was licensed and guidance published. Guidance was generally more restrictive than regulatory authorisation. While there was broad agreement in recommending vaccination for travellers with laboratory-confirmed prior dengue infection, recommendations for those without documented infection varied widely. All advisory bodies considered destination-specific dengue risk but differed in whether and how they used travel duration, repeated or cumulative exposure, traveller characteristics and host susceptibility factors to determine vaccine eligibility. Some recommendations restricted vaccination to travellers with prior dengue infection, whereas others extended eligibility to selected travellers without documented prior infection or recommended vaccination irrespective of serostatus based on exposure risk. Approaches also differed in assessment of prior dengue infection and whether completion of the two-dose series before travel was required. Conclusions Variation in Qdenga guidance reflects differences in how advisory bodies interpret shared evidence and manage uncertainty arising from data gaps and differences between trial populations and travellers. Additional data on vaccine effectiveness and clinical outcomes among seronegative travellers and older adults may help reduce uncertainty and support greater alignment of future recommendations. Regardless, transparency and shared clinical decision-making remain essential when discussing dengue vaccination with travellers.

analysis.summary_en: This comparative analysis evaluates national guidance for the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine in travellers using survey data from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries. While there is consensus on vaccinating travellers with prior dengue infection, recommendations for seronegative individuals vary significantly, with guidance generally being more restrictive than regulatory authorisation. Differences in recommendations stem from varying interpretations of shared evidence and uncertainty due to data gaps, particularly regarding vaccine effectiveness in seronegative travellers and older adults. The review highlights the need for additional data in these populations to align future recommendations and emphasizes the importance of transparency and shared clinical decision-making in vaccination discussions.
