papers.title_zh: 共享证据,不同建议:针对各国旅行者的 Qdenga (TAK-003) 登革热 疫苗 指南的比较分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengue is an increasingly important cause of illness in travellers, and Qdenga (TAK-003) is the first dengue vaccine incorporated into guidance for travellers in multiple countries. However, clinicians and travellers may encounter differing recommendations across jurisdictions. This study compared guidance on the use of Qdenga in travellers across countries. Methods We conducted a comparative analysis of national guidance on Qdenga use for travellers across countries, using survey data and structured review of publicly available recommendations. Guidance was synthesised according to dengue immune status and mapped across recurring decision domains. Results Survey responses were obtained from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries between March and April 2026, including twelve non-endemic countries where Qdenga was licensed and guidance published. Guidance was generally more restrictive than regulatory authorisation. While there was broad agreement in recommending vaccination for travellers with laboratory-confirmed prior dengue infection, recommendations for those without documented infection varied widely. All advisory bodies considered destination-specific dengue risk but differed in whether and how they used travel duration, repeated or cumulative exposure, traveller characteristics and host susceptibility factors to determine vaccine eligibility. Some recommendations restricted vaccination to travellers with prior dengue infection, whereas others extended eligibility to selected travellers without documented prior infection or recommended vaccination irrespective of serostatus based on exposure risk. Approaches also differed in assessment of prior dengue infection and whether completion of the two-dose series before travel was required. Conclusions Variation in Qdenga guidance reflects differences in how advisory bodies interpret shared evidence and manage uncertainty arising from data gaps and differences between trial populations and travellers. Additional data on vaccine effectiveness and clinical outcomes among seronegative travellers and older adults may help reduce uncertainty and support greater alignment of future recommendations. Regardless, transparency and shared clinical decision-making remain essential when discussing dengue vaccination with travellers.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热是旅行者中日益重要的疾病原因,Qdenga (TAK-003) 是第一个纳入多个国家旅行者指南的登革热 疫苗。然而,临床医生和旅行者可能会在不同司法管辖区遇到不同的建议。这项研究比较了各国旅行者使用 Qdenga 的指南。方法 我们利用调查数据和对公开建议的结构化审查,对各国旅行者使用 Qdenga 的国家指南进行了比较分析。根据登革热免疫状态合成指南,并在重复决策域中进行映射。结果 2026 年 3 月至 4 月期间,从 17 个国家的 18 个咨询机构获得了调查回复,其中包括 Qdenga 获得许可并发布指南的 12 个非流行国家。指导通常比监管授权更具限制性。虽然人们普遍同意向实验室确诊的既往登革热感染者推荐 疫苗接种,但对于没有感染记录的旅行者的建议差异很大。所有咨询机构都考虑了目的地特定的登革热风险,但在是否以及如何使用旅行持续时间、重复或累积暴露、旅行者特征和 宿主 易感因素来确定 疫苗 资格方面有所不同。一些建议将 疫苗接种 限制为既往感染过登革热的旅行者,而另一些建议将资格扩大到没有既往感染记录的特定旅行者,或根据暴露风险推荐 疫苗接种,无论血清状态如何。在评估既往登革热感染以及是否需要在旅行前完成两剂系列疫苗方面,方法也有所不同。结论 Qdenga 指南的差异反映了咨询机构如何解释共享证据以及管理因数据差距以及试验人群和旅行者之间的差异而产生的不确定性的差异。关于 疫苗 在血清阴性旅行者和老年人中的有效性和临床结果的更多数据可能有助于减少不确定性并支持未来建议的更大一致性。无论如何,在与旅行者讨论登革热 疫苗接种 时,透明度和共同的临床决策仍然至关重要。

papers.title: Delayed Plasma Leakage Associated with Dengue Infection: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) is characterized by plasma leakage during the critical phase of illness, typically occurring around defervescence between illness days 4 and 7. Delayed plasma leakage beyond this period is rarely described. We report a diagnostically challenging case of dengue in a previously healthy young woman from a dengue-endemic region, in whom plasma leakage was detected on illness day 13, raising the possibility of a delayed critical phase, though a sequential febrile illness followed by dengue infection could not be excluded. The patient initially developed high-grade fever, vomiting, arthralgia, and myalgia, which resolved after three days. After a three-day period of transient clinical improvement, severe headache, abdominal pain, and recurrent vomiting developed without recurrence of fever. She was admitted on day 12 with thrombocytopenia and marked transaminitis. On day 13 of illness, ultrasonography demonstrated free fluid in the hepatorenal pouch and right pleural cavity, consistent with plasma leakage, while dengue IgM and IgG antibodies were positive. The patient was managed as DHF with careful fluid monitoring and recovered uneventfully. This case highlights the importance of considering dengue in patients from endemic settings even when presentation is atypical, afebrile, or temporally delayed. Although a delayed critical phase is possible, sequential febrile illnesses with subsequent dengue infection could not be excluded because early virological confirmation was unavailable. Careful monitoring for thrombocytopenia and plasma leakage remains essential even in apparently recovering patients.

papers.title_zh: 与登革热感染相关的延迟血浆泄漏:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) is characterized by plasma leakage during the critical phase of illness, typically occurring around defervescence between illness days 4 and 7. Delayed plasma leakage beyond this period is rarely described. We report a diagnostically challenging case of dengue in a previously healthy young woman from a dengue-endemic region, in whom plasma leakage was detected on illness day 13, raising the possibility of a delayed critical phase, though a sequential febrile illness followed by dengue infection could not be excluded. The patient initially developed high-grade fever, vomiting, arthralgia, and myalgia, which resolved after three days. After a three-day period of transient clinical improvement, severe headache, abdominal pain, and recurrent vomiting developed without recurrence of fever. She was admitted on day 12 with thrombocytopenia and marked transaminitis. On day 13 of illness, ultrasonography demonstrated free fluid in the hepatorenal pouch and right pleural cavity, consistent with plasma leakage, while dengue IgM and IgG antibodies were positive. The patient was managed as DHF with careful fluid monitoring and recovered uneventfully. This case highlights the importance of considering dengue in patients from endemic settings even when presentation is atypical, afebrile, or temporally delayed. Although a delayed critical phase is possible, sequential febrile illnesses with subsequent dengue infection could not be excluded because early virological confirmation was unavailable. Careful monitoring for thrombocytopenia and plasma leakage remains essential even in apparently recovering patients.

papers.title: Extinction pathways in dengue-Zika multi-pathogen systems with antibody-dependent enhancement
papers.abstract: Introduction Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) creates complex multi-pathogen dynamics that fundamentally alter extinction probabilities in co-circulating dengue and Zika viruses. Methods We develop a stochastic framework for five co-circulating pathogens (dengue serotypes 1 -4 and Zika) with asymmetric ADE. Using WKB large-deviation theory, we compute extinction actions and most-probable pathways via Minimum Action, Nudged Elastic Band, and adaptive SVD methods. WKB actions are validated against Monte Carlo simulations (Pearson r = 0.98, max relative error 0.3%). Results The model predicts that DENV4 acts as a keystone pathogen: its elimination triggers a cascade (DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika) that is exponentially more probable than direct multi-pathogen extinction. The parameter space separates into three extinction regimes –sequential, pairwise, and total collapse –with hysteresis near η≈2.8 Sensitivity analysis shows keystone identity is stable under ±20% ADE matrix perturbations. In a symmetric n-pathogen limit on the symmetric invariant manifold, single-serotype extinction action decreases as 1/n while global elimination action grows as n ·S sym . Discussion Within this symmetric idealization, this provides a possible mechanistic reference point for understanding how serotype diversity could simultaneously promote local vulnerability and global persistence. Whether a similar relationship holds in the fully asymmetric dengue-Zika system is an open question. Limitations include the direct-transmission approximation (quantitative error < 15%) and time-averaged ADE. All predictions are model-based and require empirical validation.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Applied Mathematics and Statistics

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 创建了复杂的多病原体动力学,从根本​​上改变了共同传播的登革热和寨卡病毒的灭绝概率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究为五种共同循环的病原体(包括登革热血清型 1-4 和具有不对称 ADE 的寨卡病毒)开发了一个随机框架。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 WKB 大偏差理论通过最小作用、微移弹性带和自适应 SVD 方法计算灭绝作用和最可能的路径,并根据蒙特卡罗模拟验证 WKB 作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型预测 DENV4 作为关键病原体,其消除会触发级联(DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika),其概率比直接多病原体灭绝的可能性高出指数级,参数空间分为三个灭绝机制,并且关键身份在 ±20% ADE 矩阵扰动下保持稳定。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在对称理想化的情况下,单一血清型灭绝行动减少了 1/n,而全球消除行动却在增长,这一发现为理解血清型多样性如何同时促进局部脆弱性和全球持久性提供了机械参考点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所提供的证据并未报告对 监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态学、风险评估、预防或未来研究的具体影响。

papers.title_zh: 利用 抗体依赖性增强 确定登革热-寨卡病毒多病原体系统的灭绝途径
papers.source_body_en: Introduction Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) creates complex multi-pathogen dynamics that fundamentally alter extinction probabilities in co-circulating dengue and Zika viruses. Methods We develop a stochastic framework for five co-circulating pathogens (dengue serotypes 1 -4 and Zika) with asymmetric ADE. Using WKB large-deviation theory, we compute extinction actions and most-probable pathways via Minimum Action, Nudged Elastic Band, and adaptive SVD methods. WKB actions are validated against Monte Carlo simulations (Pearson r = 0.98, max relative error 0.3%). Results The model predicts that DENV4 acts as a keystone pathogen: its elimination triggers a cascade (DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika) that is exponentially more probable than direct multi-pathogen extinction. The parameter space separates into three extinction regimes –sequential, pairwise, and total collapse –with hysteresis near η≈2.8 Sensitivity analysis shows keystone identity is stable under ±20% ADE matrix perturbations. In a symmetric n-pathogen limit on the symmetric invariant manifold, single-serotype extinction action decreases as 1/n while global elimination action grows as n ·S sym . Discussion Within this symmetric idealization, this provides a possible mechanistic reference point for understanding how serotype diversity could simultaneously promote local vulnerability and global persistence. Whether a similar relationship holds in the fully asymmetric dengue-Zika system is an open question. Limitations include the direct-transmission approximation (quantitative error < 15%) and time-averaged ADE. All predictions are model-based and require empirical validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 创建了复杂的多病原体动力学,从根本​​上改变了共同传播的登革热和寨卡病毒的灭绝概率。方法 我们开发了一个具有不对称 ADE 的五种共循环病原体(登革热血清型 1 -4 和寨卡病毒)的随机框架。使用 WKB 大偏差理论,我们通过最小作用、微移弹性带和自适应 SVD 方法计算灭绝作用和最可能的路径。WKB 操作根据蒙特卡罗模拟进行验证(Pearson r = 0.98,最大相对误差 0.3%)。结果 该模型预测 DENV4 是一种关键病原体:它的消除会引发级联反应(DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika),其可能性比直接多病原体灭绝的可能性高出指数级。参数空间分为三种消光状态——顺序、成对和完全崩溃——滞后接近 η≈2.8 敏感性分析显示基石身份在 ±20% ADE 矩阵扰动下是稳定的。在对称不变流形上的对称 n 病原体极限中,单血清型灭绝作用以 1/n 的形式减少,而全局消除作用以 n ·S sym 的形式增长。讨论 在这种对称理想化中,这为理解血清型多样性如何同时促进局部脆弱性和全球持久性提供了可能的机械参考点。在完全不对称的登革热-寨卡病毒系统中是否存在类似的关系是一个悬而未决的问题。局限性包括直接 传播 近似(定量误差 < 15%)和时间平均 ADE。所有预测都是基于模型的,需要经验验证。

papers.title: Improving Prediction of Dengue Outbreaks Using Attention-based LSTM Model with Honey Badger Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning
papers.abstract: Climate Change Poses a Significant Challenge to the Current Dynamics of Disease Outbreaks. This Study Improves Outbreak Prediction Using an Attention-Based LSTM Model Optimized by the Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) for Hyperparameter Tuning. Using Disease, Climate, and Geographic Data From 2015–2024 in Different Barangays in Koronadal, South Cotabato, the Model Predicts Incidence Over 1-, 3-, 6-, and 12-Month Horizons. Attention Mechanisms Enhanced Long-Term Pattern Detection, While HBA Reduces Overfitting and Boosts Accuracy. Results Show the HBA-LSTM Reduces Mean Squared Error by 43.7% Over Standard LSTM and 22.2% Over Attention Models. Similar Reductions are Seen in RMSE, MAE, and MAPE. Though Effective, Further Tuning and Alternative Architectures are Suggested for Improved Generalization.
papers.journal: International Journal of Latest Technology in Engineering Management & Applied Science

analysis.summary_en: Addressing the challenge of climate change on disease dynamics, this study developed an attention-based LSTM model optimized with the Honey Badger Algorithm to predict dengue outbreaks. Using data from 2015–2024 in Koronadal, South Cotabato, the model predicted incidence over various time horizons. Results demonstrated that the HBA-LSTM reduced mean squared error by 43.7% compared to standard LSTM and 22.2% compared to attention models, with similar improvements in other error metrics. While the approach effectively enhanced long-term pattern detection and reduced overfitting, the authors note that further tuning and alternative architectures are required for better generalization.

papers.title: Envelope-dimer epitope 1 (EDE1) antibody (C10) treatment significantly reduces Zika virus replication in the male and female reproductive tracts.
papers.abstract: No effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next Zika virus (ZIKV) outbreak. ZIKV has been detected in multiple organs of infected people, including immune-privileged sites like the brain, eyes, and reproductive tract. ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern; ZIKV can be transmitted sexually or to the developing fetus of pregnant women, resulting in severe congenital defects. Here, we show that ZIKV-infected immunocompetent mice rapidly controlled viremia with no viral rebound following T cell depletion. In contrast, mice genetically deficient in B and T cells (immunodeficient mice) supported sustained ZIKV replication in all tissues examined. Treatment of ZIKV-infected immunodeficient mice with the novel nucleoside analog 7-deaza-7-fluoro-2'-C-methyladenosine (DFMA) significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival, validating immunodeficient mice for efficacy studies of ZIKV prevention and therapeutic approaches. Importantly, we demonstrate that treatment of ZIKV-infected animals with a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) suppressed systemic ZIKV replication, including in the brain, eye, and male and female reproductive tracts.IMPORTANCESince 2007, Zika virus (ZIKV) infections have been documented in over 80 countries and territories, resulting in two major outbreaks thus far. ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern as ZIKV can be transmitted sexually or to the developing fetus of pregnant women, resulting in severe congenital defects. Currently, no effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next outbreak. Here, we developed a preclinical animal model for ZIKV infection that we used to evaluate the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody for prevention/treatment of ZIKV infection. The antibody suppressed virus replication in blood and tissues, including the reproductive tract, suggesting that passive administration of ZIKV neutralizing antibodies could be used during future ZIKV outbreaks in high-risk populations to prevent ZIKV transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: No effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next Zika virus (ZIKV) outbreak, and ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern due to risks of sexual transmission and severe congenital defects.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a preclinical animal model for ZIKV infection using immunocompetent mice and genetically immunodeficient mice to evaluate the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody.
analysis.methods: Researchers evaluated the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) and the nucleoside analog 7-deaza-7-fluoro-2'-C-methyladenosine (DFMA) in ZIKV-infected mice, measuring outcomes including viremia, survival, and viral replication in tissues.
analysis.main_results: Treatment of ZIKV-infected immunodeficient mice with DFMA significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival, while treatment with the EDE1 antibody suppressed systemic ZIKV replication in the blood, brain, eye, and male and female reproductive tracts.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as validating immunodeficient mice for efficacy studies and demonstrating that a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody can suppress ZIKV replication in immune-privileged sites.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that passive administration of ZIKV neutralizing antibodies could be used during future ZIKV outbreaks in high-risk populations to prevent ZIKV transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations, but the evidence strength is assessed as moderate because the data are derived from an abstract-only preclinical animal model.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed the lack of effective therapies for Zika virus (ZIKV) by developing a preclinical mouse model to test therapeutic interventions. Researchers evaluated the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) and a nucleoside analog (DFMA) in both immunocompetent and immunodeficient mice. Results showed that DFMA treatment significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival in immunodeficient mice, while the EDE1 antibody suppressed systemic ZIKV replication, including in the brain, eyes, and reproductive tracts. These findings validate the use of immunodeficient mice for ZIKV efficacy studies and suggest that passive antibody administration could be a viable strategy to prevent transmission during future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前尚无有效的疗法或 疫苗 可以预防下一个寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 暴发,并且由于 传播 的性风险和严重的先天缺陷,生殖道中的 ZIKV 复制受到高度关注。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用免疫功能正常的小鼠和遗传免疫缺陷的小鼠开发了 ZIKV 感染的临床前动物模型,以评估 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体的功效。

elements_zh.main_results: 使用 DFMA 治疗 ZIKV 感染的免疫缺陷小鼠的 治疗 可显着减少病毒血症并延长生存期,而使用 EDE1 抗体的 治疗 则可抑制血液、大脑、眼睛以及男性和女性生殖道中的全身 ZIKV 复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为验证免疫缺陷小鼠的功效研究,并证明 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体可以抑制 ZIKV 在免疫特权位点的复制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在未来的 ZIKV 暴发 高危人群中,可以使用被动施用 ZIKV 中和抗体来预防 ZIKV 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制,但证据强度被评估为中等,因为数据来自仅抽象的临床前动物模型。

analysis_zh.main_results: 使用 DFMA 治疗 ZIKV 感染的免疫缺陷小鼠的 治疗 可显着减少病毒血症并延长生存期,而使用 EDE1 抗体的 治疗 则可抑制血液、大脑、眼睛以及男性和女性生殖道中的全身 ZIKV 复制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为验证免疫缺陷小鼠的功效研究,并证明 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体可以抑制 ZIKV 在免疫特权位点的复制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在未来的 ZIKV 暴发 高危人群中,可以使用被动施用 ZIKV 中和抗体来预防 ZIKV 传播。

papers.title: Integrated surveillance of arboviruses in febrile patients from the Brazilian Amazon reveals complex co-circulation dynamics and hidden viral diversity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study characterized arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, from 2021 to 2023. Among 708 participants, 34.3% had laboratory-confirmed infections, with DENV accounting for 37.9% of cases and DENV+CHIKV being the most common coinfection. Genomic analysis identified the circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III and II. Metagenomic sequencing of negative samples detected other viral agents. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 虫媒病毒感染是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战,重叠的症状和有限的实验室访问阻碍了临床 诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。该研究招募了 708 名 5 岁或以上的参与者,这些参与者均出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天,所有参与者的疟疾厚血涂片均呈阴性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的 登革病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和 Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本接受基于扩增子的 基因组 测序进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 708 名登记参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染,其中包括 92 名(37.9%)登革热病毒病例。该研究确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(大都会)的循环。此外,83 个 (34.2%) 实验室资料与双重感染相符,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,其特征是同时存在多种 DENV 基因型以及 DENV 和 CHIKV 双重感染的高频率。作者将这些结果解释为支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合 监测 策略必要性的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持实施结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合 监测 策略来管理虫媒病毒威胁。这些策略对于理解复杂的 传播 动力学和改善具有多种共循环虫媒病毒的区域的临床 诊断 至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的研究局限性或证据强度的详细评估。证据仅来自摘要,这限制了评估潜在偏差、混杂因素或研究结果在研究背景之外的普遍性的能力。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 虫媒病毒感染是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战,重叠的症状和有限的实验室访问阻碍了临床 诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。该研究招募了 708 名 5 岁或以上的参与者,这些参与者均出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天,所有参与者的疟疾厚血涂片均呈阴性。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的 登革病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和 Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本接受基于扩增子的 基因组 测序进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 708 名登记参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染,其中包括 92 名(37.9%)登革热病毒病例。该研究确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(大都会)的循环。此外,83 个 (34.2%) 实验室资料与双重感染相符,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,其特征是同时存在多种 DENV 基因型以及 DENV 和 CHIKV 双重感染的高频率。作者将这些结果解释为支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合 监测 策略必要性的证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持实施结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合 监测 策略来管理虫媒病毒威胁。这些策略对于理解复杂的 传播 动力学和改善具有多种共循环虫媒病毒的区域的临床 诊断 至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的研究局限性或证据强度的详细评估。证据仅来自摘要,这限制了评估潜在偏差、混杂因素或研究结果在研究背景之外的普遍性的能力。

papers.title: Bridging surveillance gaps in dengue: a hierarchical model integrating mixed data sources for transmission estimation and vaccine targeting
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed the challenge of incomplete dengue surveillance data by developing a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that integrates age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys. Applied to 128 districts in Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in force of infection and reporting rates. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 估计登革热感染力对于了解 监测 动态和制定干预计划至关重要,但估计所需的流行环境中的 监测 数据通常不完整,且格式各异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究将贝叶斯分层催化模型应用于印度尼西亚爪哇和巴厘岛的 128 个地区,涵盖 2016 年至 2024 年期间。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型将年龄分层病例数据、汇总病例数据和 血清流行率 调查联合拟合在一个框架内,并结合外部协变量以提高参数可识别性。
elements_zh.main_results: 综合验证表明,即使大多数地区仅提供汇总数据,仅协变量也能恢复准确的感染点估计强度,但这样做的不确定性校准不佳;有必要通过一次 血清流行率 调查来锚定模型,以使可信的区间覆盖范围接近名义值。该模型揭示了感染力和报告率的显着空间异质性。爪哇的许多地区超出了世界卫生组织建议的 疫苗 引入阈值,但在使用报告的 发病率 作为优先标准时被归类为低优先级,特别是在 监测 较弱的地区。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于模型的 血清流行率 估计,集成了多个数据源,为识别 疫苗 引入的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础,并且比报告的 发病率 更不易受到 监测 偏差的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,与单独使用报告的 发病率 相比,整合多个数据源为确定登革热 疫苗 引入的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础。

papers.title_zh: 弥合登革热中的 监测 差距:集成混合数据源的分层模型,用于 传播 估计和 疫苗 定位
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 估计登革热感染力 (FOI) 对于了解 监测 动态和制定干预计划至关重要,但估计所需的流行环境中的 监测 数据通常不完整,且格式各异。我们开发了一个贝叶斯分层催化模型,该模型在单一框架内联合拟合年龄分层病例数据、汇总病例数据和 血清流行率 调查,并结合外部协变量以提高参数可识别性。综合验证表明,即使大多数地区仅提供汇总数据,仅协变量也能恢复准确的 FOI 点估计,但这样做的不确定性校准不佳;有必要通过一次 血清流行率 调查来锚定模型,以使可信的区间覆盖范围接近名义值。该模型应用于印度尼西亚爪哇岛和巴厘岛的 128 个地区(2016-2024 年),揭示了 FOI 和报告率的显着空间异质性。爪哇的许多地区超出了世界卫生组织建议的 疫苗 引入阈值,但在使用报告的 发病率 作为优先标准时被归类为低优先级,特别是在 监测 较弱的地区。基于模型的 血清流行率 估计,集成了多个数据源,为识别 疫苗 引入的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础,并且比报告的 发病率 更不易受到 监测 偏差的影响。

papers.title: Hubungan Jumlah Trombosit Dengan Nilai Hematokrit Pada Infeksi Sekunder Dengue Di RSUD Pasar Rebo
papers.abstract: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat serius di Indonesia dengan prevalensi tinggi, khususnya pada kasus infeksi sekunder yang beresiko menimbulkan manifestasi lebih berat. Perubahan jumlah trombosit dan nilai hematokrit sering digunakan sebagai indikator laboratorium, namun hasil penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan variasi temuan terkait hubungan keduanya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui hubungan antara jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada pasien infeksi sekunder dengue di RSUD Pasar Rebo. Penelitian ini menggunakan data sekunder dengan menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dan pendekatan cross sectional. Data diperoleh dari rekam medis pasien rawat inap dengan diagnosis infeksi sekunder dengue yang dikonfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan serologi IgG dan IgM positif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dan dianalisis menggunakan uji univariat serta bivariat dengan korelasi Spearman. Pada penelitian ini ditemukan bahwa 79,3% pasien dengan infeksi dengue sekunder mengalami trombositopenia tanpa disertai hemokonsentrasi. Kesimpulan yang didapat adalah tidak terdapat hubungan jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada infeksi sekunder dengue.

papers.title: Increasing Frequency of Secondary Dengue Infections in Sequential Outbreaks (2016–2024)—Clinical Impact and Diagnostic Challenges
papers.abstract: Successive dengue virus (DENV) outbreaks progressively reshape population immunity, influencing disease expression and diagnostic performance. This study evaluated the impact of secondary infections across sequential outbreaks on disease severity markers, serotype dynamics, and the agreement between routinely used direct diagnostic methods. This retrospective study analyzed 976 serum samples from three outbreaks in Misiones, Argentina. A subset of 318 samples, including 107 RT-PCR/NS1-negative samples, was used to compare NS1 antigen rapid diagnostic tests (NS1 Ag) and RT-PCR. Viral serotypes and clinical and laboratory severity markers were evaluated. Secondary infections increased from 31.1% in 2016 to 43.2% in 2019 and 53.1% in 2024 (p < 0.001). Serotype distribution shifted from DENV-1 predominance in 2016 (95.1%) to DENV-1/DENV-4 co-circulation in 2019 (60.7%/39.3%) and DENV-2 predominance in 2024 (97.6%). Secondary infections were associated with increased frequency of laboratory severity markers, particularly in 2024, including higher hematocrit, liver enzyme levels and lower leukocyte and platelet counts. Concordance between NS1 Ag and RT-PCR was lower in secondary infections (κ = 0.457 vs. The increasing frequency of secondary infections may influence laboratory markers associated with dengue severity and reduce the diagnostic concordance between direct detection methods, highlighting the need for optimized surveillance and diagnostic strategies during dengue outbreaks.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate how secondary dengue infections across sequential outbreaks affect disease severity markers, serotype dynamics, and diagnostic agreement between direct methods.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that the rising frequency of secondary dengue infections may influence disease severity and diagnostic accuracy, emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and diagnostic strategies during outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the increasing frequency of secondary dengue infections across three outbreaks in Misiones, Argentina, from 2016 to 2024. It highlights how these infections influence disease severity markers and diagnostic agreement between NS1 Ag and RT-PCR tests. The research shows a shift in serotype distribution, with DENV-1 predominance in 2016, DENV-1/DENV-4 co-circulation in 2019, and DENV-2 dominance in 2024. The findings suggest that secondary infections are associated with more severe clinical and laboratory outcomes, particularly in 2024. The study underscores the importance of adapting surveillance and diagnostic strategies to account for these changes. However, the retrospective nature of the study and potential biases limit the strength of the evidence, though the observed trends are consistent and significant.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估连续 暴发 的继发性登革热感染如何影响疾病严重程度标志物、血清型动态以及直接方法之间的诊断一致性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性研究分析了 2016 年至 2024 年间来自阿根廷米西奥内斯省三例登革热 暴发 的 976 份血清样本,重点研究继发感染对临床和实验室结果的影响。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,继发感染频率的增加与血清型分布的变化以及实验室严重程度标志物的相关性有关,特别是在 2024 年。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,继发性登革热感染频率的上升可能会影响疾病的严重程度和诊断准确性,强调需要改进 监测 和 监测 期间的诊断策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于血清样本,这可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力,尽管由于观察到明显的趋势,证据强度适中。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,继发感染频率的增加与血清型分布的变化以及实验室严重程度标志物的相关性有关,特别是在 2024 年。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,继发性登革热感染频率的上升可能会影响疾病的严重程度和诊断准确性,强调需要改进 监测 和 监测 期间的诊断策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于血清样本,这可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力,尽管由于观察到明显的趋势,证据强度适中。

papers.full_text: Les moustiques invasifs ne constituent pas seulement une menace sanitaire : ils représentent aussi un coût économique majeur. Une étude internationale estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les maladies transmises par les moustiques Aedes ont engendré au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars de pertes dans le monde. Plus frappant encore, les dépenses consacrées à la prévention restent très inférieures aux coûts supportés une fois les épidémies déclarées. Ils sont petits, à peine visibles, et pourtant leur impact économique atteint une ampleur comparable à celle de certaines crises sanitaires majeures. Les moustiques invasifs du genre Aedes – notamment Aedes albopictus (moustique tigre) et Aedes aegypti (son cousin, moins connu en Europe, le moustique de la fièvre jaune)- ne se contentent pas de troubler nos soirées estivales, ils nous transmettent les virus de la dengue, de la fièvre jaune, chikungunya ou encore Zika et, ce faisant, ils engendrent également des coûts considérables pour les systèmes de santé, les collectivités et les ménages du monde entier. Dans une étude publiée en 2024 dans Science of The Total Environment on estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les coûts économiques liés à ces moustiques et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent, atteignent au minimum 94,7 milliards (en dollars de 2022). Les estimations hautes suggèrent elles un coût total supérieur à 300 milliards lorsque les séquelles à long terme sont prises en compte, soit un montant comparable au coût total de l’ouragan Katrina, l’une des catastrophes naturelles les plus coûteuses de l’histoire contemporaine, et supérieur à ceux de la catastrophe pétrolière de Deepwater Horizon en 2010 dans le golfe du Mexique. Derrière ce chiffre impressionnant, on trouve une réalité plus préoccupante encore : cette évaluation est sans doute largement sous-estimée et, contrairement à une catastrophe ponctuelle, ces coûts s’accumulent année après année. Et surtout, elle révèle un déséquilibre majeur dans nos choix collectifs : nous dépensons beaucoup plus pour réparer les dégâts que pour prévenir les crises, environ dix fois plus. Une expansion silencieuse, un coût croissant Pour comprendre ces montants colossaux, il faut d’abord regarder l’expansion silencieuse des moustiques concernés. Issus de régions tropicales, les moustiques Aedes ont étendu leur aire de répartition à un rythme soutenu. Aedes aegypti, originaire d’Afrique, est aujourd’hui présent dans une grande partie des régions tropicales et subtropicales d’Amérique, d’Asie et d’Océanie. Son aire de répartition s’est progressivement étendue sous l’effet des échanges commerciaux et de l’urbanisation. Aedes albopictus, le moustique tigre, lui, a colonisé le monde plus tardivement, à partir des années 1970, en provenance d’Asie. Portés par la mondialisation des échanges (commerce international, transport maritime et aérien), l’urbanisation rapide et souvent mal planifiée, ainsi que par le réchauffement climatique, ces vecteurs de virus se sont implantés sur tous les continents, y compris en Europe et en Amérique du Nord. Leur succès écologique a une conséquence directe : l’augmentation du nombre d’épidémies. La dengue, autrefois confinée à certaines régions tropicales, est devenue l’une des maladies virales à transmission vectorielle les plus répandues au monde. Présente dans plus de 100 pays, elle connaît des flambées de plus en plus fréquentes et de plus en plus importantes, avec des niveaux records observés ces dernières années. En 2023 et 2024, plusieurs pays d’Amérique latine, dont le Brésil et l’Argentine, ont enregistré des épidémies historiques comptant plusieurs millions de cas. Le chikungunya et le Zika ont provoqué des crises sanitaires majeures depuis le début des années 2000, avec des répercussions sanitaires durables, notamment des complications neurologiques et congénitales. Cette crise sanitaire est aussi une crise économique, dont les conséquences restent largement sous-estimées dans le débat public. 94,7 milliards de dollars : une estimation minimale Notre équipe a compilé les données issues de la base internationale InvaCost) qui recense les coûts économiques associés aux espèces invasives. Sur une période de 45 ans (1975-2020), nous avons identifié au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars (soit environ 105 milliards en dollars 2026) de coûts cumulés liés aux moustiques Aedes et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent. Cela représente en moyenne plus de 3 milliards de dollars par an, avec des pics spectaculaires : en 2013, la facture a dépassé les 20 milliards de dollars. Ces montants incluent plusieurs types de dépenses : les coûts médicaux (hospitalisations, consultations, traitements), les pertes de productivité liées aux arrêts de travail, les dépenses publiques de surveillance et de lutte antivectorielle (limitation des populations de moustiques par divers moyens dont les campagnes de participation communautaire pour la réduction d’eaux stagnantes, les larvicides, où les insecticides), ainsi que certains impacts économiques indirects (comme l’absentéisme ou des baisses de productivité). La dengue représente à elle seule près de 80 % des coûts totaux estimés. Le chikungunya et le Zika, bien que plus ponctuels dans leur émergence, contribuent également de manière significative dans la dernière décennie, reflétant plusieurs grandes crises épidémiques sur la période. Mais ces chiffres impressionnants ne représentent pourtant qu’une partie de la réalité. Une sous-estimation structurelle De fait, les 94,7 milliards de dollars identifiés ne représentent que les coûts documentés et publiés dans la littérature scientifique ou institutionnelle. Il ne s’agit pas d’estimations ni d’extrapolations. Or, de nombreux pays, notamment à revenu faible ou intermédiaire, ne disposent pas des moyens pour mesurer et documenter ces impacts économiques. Les dépenses informelles des ménages, les pertes économiques non déclarées, les conséquences à long terme sur la santé (handicaps, troubles neurologiques, complications congénitales liées au Zika), ou encore les effets sur le tourisme et l’attractivité économique (le nombre de visiteurs chute drastiquement dans les pays connaissant une épidémie) sont rarement quantifiés. Autrement dit, la facture réelle pourrait être bien plus élevée. Ce biais révèle en outre une inégalité structurelle : les pays les plus touchés sont souvent ceux qui disposent des systèmes de surveillance les moins robustes, en particulier dans plusieurs régions d’Asie du Sud-Est, d’Afrique subsaharienne et d’Amérique latine. Le manque de données n’est pas synonyme d’absence de coût : il traduit plutôt une invisibilisation économique des régions les plus vulnérables. Réagir et soigner plutôt que prévenir : un choix coûteux Anticiper ces conséquences et investir dans la prévention, la surveillance et la gestion intégrée des vecteurs apparaît donc essentiel pour limiter les effets sanitaires, économiques et sociaux des futures épidémies. Les données montrent cependant que les coûts liés aux « dommages et pertes » – c’est-à-dire les conséquences des maladies une fois qu’elles surviennent – sont largement supérieurs aux dépenses consacrées à la prévention et à la gestion. En d’autres termes, on dépense beaucoup plus en réaction aux épidémies que pour les empêcher. Les campagnes de démoustication, la surveillance entomologique, l’amélioration des infrastructures urbaines (gestion des eaux stagnantes, assainissement), ou encore la recherche sur les méthodes innovantes de contrôle des populations de moustiques (comme la dissémination de moustiques porteurs de Wolbachia ou de mâles stériles) restent sous-financées par rapport à l’ampleur des dommages constatés. Ce déséquilibre pose une question centrale de politique publique : pourquoi attendons-nous que la crise éclate pour agir ? Read more: Les lâchers de moustiques modifiés pour lutter contre la dengue, le chikungunya ou la fièvre jaune La réponse est en partie politique et budgétaire. Les dépenses de prévention sont souvent moins visibles, moins médiatisées, et leurs bénéfices sont difficiles à attribuer directement. À l’inverse, les coûts des épidémies apparaissent brutalement dans les statistiques hospitalières et économiques. Mais cette logique court-termiste se révèle économiquement inefficace. Les données montrent pourtant qu’un investissement accru dans la prévention pourrait réduire significativement la charge économique globale à long terme. Une problématique sociale mondiale Au-delà des chiffres, l’enjeu est profondément social. Les maladies transmises par les moustiques Aedes touchent de manière disproportionnée les populations urbaines défavorisées, vivant dans des environnements où l’accès à l’eau potable, à l’assainissement et aux infrastructures sanitaires est limité. Les inégalités socio-économiques favorisent la prolifération des moustiques : stockage d’eau dans des récipients ouverts, absence de systèmes d’évacuation performants, habitat dense et précaire. Les populations les plus vulnérables cumulent donc les risques sanitaires et les pertes économiques. Lorsqu’un membre d’un foyer tombe malade, les conséquences dépassent le simple coût médical : perte de revenus, déscolarisation temporaire des enfants, endettement pour financer les soins. À l’échelle collective, ces micro-chocs économiques s’additionnent pour former un fardeau macroéconomique. La mondialisation du phénomène ajoute une dimension supplémentaire : même les pays tempérés, longtemps considérés comme à l’abri, voient désormais l’implantation durable de Aedes albopictus. Les épisodes autochtones de dengue ou de chikungunya en Europe illustrent cette nouvelle réalité et les récentes projections climatiques suggèrent que le potentiel de transmission pourrait encore s’étendre dans les décennies à venir. La question n’est plus celle d’un « problème tropical », mais d’un enjeu global. Read more: Virus « exotiques » dans l’Hexagone : Que faut-il savoir du chikungunya ? Une alerte et une opportunité Cette lecture économique permet de renouveler notre compréhension d’un problème souvent abordé sous le seul angle sanitaire. En mettant un coût sur les conséquences des invasions de moustiques Aedes, cette étude déplace le débat vers le terrain des politiques publiques et des arbitrages budgétaires. Les moustiques ne sont pas seulement une nuisance estivale. Ils représentent un coût structurel croissant pour les systèmes de santé, les économies nationales et les ménages. Dans un monde marqué par l’intensification des échanges et les bouleversements climatiques, ils illustrent une réalité concrète : certains impacts économiques des transformations environnementales ne sont ni abstraits ni lointains. Ils se traduisent en milliards de dollars, en inégalités sociales accrues et en systèmes de santé sous tension. Reconnaître l’ampleur économique du phénomène conduit ainsi à changer de perspective : dans un contexte de mondialisation des échanges et de changement climatique, la lutte antivectorielle n’est plus seulement une mesure de santé publique. Elle constitue un investissement collectif destiné à éviter des coûts sanitaires, sociaux et économiques bien plus élevés demain.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Invasive Aedes mosquitoes pose a major public health threat and cause significant economic losses, yet prevention spending remains insufficient compared to outbreak response costs. This study aimed to quantify the global economic burden of Aedes-transmitted diseases, including dengue, and to highlight the disparity between reactive expenditures and preventive investments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors compiled data from the international InvaCost database to assess economic costs associated with invasive species over a 45-year period from 1975 to 2020. The analysis focused on global costs related to Aedes mosquitoes and the diseases they transmit, including dengue, chikungunya, and Zika, across affected countries.
analysis.methods: The team identified and aggregated documented costs from scientific and institutional literature, converting figures to 2022 US dollars. The analysis included direct medical costs, lost productivity, public vector control expenditures, and indirect economic impacts, while noting that estimates likely represent a minimum due to underreporting.
analysis.main_results: The study estimated a minimum cumulative cost of 94.7 billion US dollars (approximately 105 billion in 2026 dollars) attributable to Aedes mosquitoes and their associated diseases between 1975 and 2020. Les moustiques invasifs du genre Aedes – notamment Aedes albopictus (moustique tigre) et Aedes aegypti (son cousin, moins connu en Europe, le moustique de la fièvre jaune)- ne se contentent pas de troubler nos soirées estivales, ils nous transmettent les virus de la dengue, de la fièvre jaune, chikungunya ou encore Zika et, ce faisant, ils engendrent également des coûts considérables pour les systèmes de santé, les collectivités et les ménages du monde entier. Dans une étude publiée en 2024 dans Science of The Total Environment on estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les coûts économiques liés à ces moustiques et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent, atteignent au minimum 94,7 milliards (en dollars de 2022). papers.title: Assessing the association between floods and dengue incidence in Vietnam: A time series study
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue incidence has increased significantly in recent decades, especially in areas undergoing rapid urbanization and frequent flooding. Floods can promote dengue transmission by creating favorable mosquito breeding sites, yet the timing and strength of this association remain unclear, particularly in Vietnam, where flood-prone areas overlap with a high dengue burden. Methods: This study assessed the relationship between flood exposure and dengue incidence across Vietnam and in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), a densely populated, flood-prone urban center. Time-series analyses were conducted using monthly data from 63 provinces (2011–2019) and weekly data from 24 districts in HCMC. Generalized additive mixed models with a negative binomial distribution were used, incorporating distributed lag linear functions to estimate cumulative and delayed effects. Analyses were stratified by season (rainy vs. Results: At the national level, flooding was associated with a 17% higher dengue incidence (relative risk [RR] = 1.17; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.94, 1.47), with the strongest effect observed 2 months after flooding (RR = 1.11; 95% CI = 1.03, 1.20). Associations were more pronounced during the rainy season (RR = 1.65; 95% CI = 1.17, 2.32). In HCMC, floods were linked to a 10.4% increase in dengue cases (RR = 1.10; 95% CI = 1.03, 1.18), with effects peaking at week 9 (RR = 1.03; 95% CI = 1.02, 1.04). Seasonal analysis revealed short-term declines in risk during the rainy season and delayed increases during the dry season, peaking at week 9 (RR = 1.03; 95% CI = 1.01, 1.04). Conclusions: These findings highlight the delayed and seasonal nature of flood-related dengue risk and support the integration of flood metrics into early warning systems and climate-informed vector control strategies.

Associations were more pronounced during the rainy season (RR = 1.65; 95% CI = 1.17, 2.32). papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue incidence has increased significantly in recent decades, especially in areas undergoing rapid urbanization and frequent flooding. Floods can promote dengue transmission by creating favorable mosquito breeding sites, yet the timing and strength of this association remain unclear, particularly in Vietnam, where flood-prone areas overlap with a high dengue burden. Methods: This study assessed the relationship between flood exposure and dengue incidence across Vietnam and in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), a densely populated, flood-prone urban center. Time-series analyses were conducted using monthly data from 63 provinces (2011–2019) and weekly data from 24 districts in HCMC. Generalized additive mixed models with a negative binomial distribution were used, incorporating distributed lag linear functions to estimate cumulative and delayed effects. Analyses were stratified by season (rainy vs. Results: At the national level, flooding was associated with a 17% higher dengue incidence (relative risk [RR] = 1.17; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.94, 1.47), with the strongest effect observed 2 months after flooding (RR = 1.11; 95% CI = 1.03, 1.20). Associations were more pronounced during the rainy season (RR = 1.65; 95% CI = 1.17, 2.32). In HCMC, floods were linked to a 10.4% increase in dengue cases (RR = 1.10; 95% CI = 1.03, 1.18), with effects peaking at week 9 (RR = 1.03; 95% CI = 1.02, 1.04). Seasonal analysis revealed short-term declines in risk during the rainy season and delayed increases during the dry season, peaking at week 9 (RR = 1.03; 95% CI = 1.01, 1.04). Conclusions: These findings highlight the delayed and seasonal nature of flood-related dengue risk and support the integration of flood metrics into early warning systems and climate-informed vector control strategies.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现强调了与洪水相关的登革热风险的延迟性和季节性特征,并支持将洪水指标纳入早期预警系统和气候知情的 媒介 控制策略中。

papers.title: Climate Variability and Dengue Dynamics: A Path Analysis in Surabaya, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue fever is a climate-sensitive vector-borne disease. While many studies have documented associations between climate variables and dengue incidence, most rely on conventional regression approaches that fail to separate direct and indirect climatic pathways, limiting mechanistic understanding and utility for environmental health. This study aims to elucidate the interconnected effects of climatic variability on dengue incidence in Surabaya. This study integrates seasonal time-series decomposition and path analysis to distinguish direct and indirect climatic pathways, sunlight duration and wind speed. Methods: A retrospective ecological design, monthly dengue incidence data from 2020 to 2024 were integrated with meteorological variables, including rainfall, temperature, humidity, sunlight duration, and wind speed. Seasonal time-series decomposition was applied to characterize temporal dynamics, followed by path analysis within a structural equation modeling framework to quantify direct and indirect climatic effects. Results and Discussion: A pronounced seasonal pattern in dengue incidence, with peaks during the rainy season. Maximum temperature, relative humidity, sunlight duration, and minimum wind speed exerted significant direct effects on dengue incidence (p < 0.05). Rainfall showed no direct association but acted as a key upstream driver influencing other climatic variables. The structural model explained 52.1% of the variance in dengue incidence, highlighting the contribution of interconnected climatic processes. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate that dengue dynamics in tropical metropolitan environments are governed by complex climate-mediated pathways rather than isolated climatic predictors. This study novel environmental epidemiological evidence to support climate-informed dengue early warning systems and adaptive vector control strategies under climate variability and urban environmental change.

papers.title: IMPLEMENTASI KEBIJAKAN PENANGGULANGAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD) DI DESA KARANGNANAS KECAMATAN SOKARAJA
papers.abstract: Implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan upaya penting dalam menekan tingginya angka kasus DBD di Indonesia. Desa Karangnanas, Kecamatan Sokaraja, Kabupaten Banyumas tercatat sebagai desa dengan jumlah kasus DBD tertinggi di Kecamatan Sokaraja pada tahun 2024. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Informan penelitian terdiri atas pemerintah desa, petugas puskesmas, kader kesehatan, dan masyarakat yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas secara umum telah berjalan cukup baik ditinjau dari aspek komunikasi, sumber daya, disposisi, dan struktur birokrasi menurut teori George C. Komunikasi dilakukan melalui penyuluhan kesehatan, kegiatan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), serta koordinasi antar pelaksana. Sumber daya didukung oleh tenaga kesehatan, kader, fasilitas, dan anggaran, meskipun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana dan partisipasi masyarakat. Disposisi pelaksana dilaksanakan melalui komitmen dan tanggung jawab dalam pelaksanaan program, sedangkan struktur birokrasi didukung oleh prosedur operasional standar dan pembagian tugas yang jelas. Faktor pendukung implementasi meliputi koordinasi lintas sektor, dukungan pemerintah desa, keterlibatan kader kesehatan, dan media edukasi masyarakat. Faktor penghambat tersebut meliputi rendahnya partisipasi sebagian masyarakat, luasnya wilayah pengawasan, keterbatasan tenaga pelaksana, serta tingginya beban kerja kader kesehatan. Kata kunci: Implementasi Kebijakan, Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD), Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), Partisipasi Masyarakat
papers.journal: GOVERNANCE Jurnal Ilmiah Kajian Politik Lokal dan Pembangunan

analysis.research_question_and_background: Implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan upaya penting dalam menekan tingginya angka kasus DBD di Indonesia, dan Desa Karangnanas tercatat sebagai desa dengan jumlah kasus DBD tertinggi di Kecamatan Sokaraja pada tahun 2024.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif di Desa Karangnanas, Kecamatan Sokaraja, Kabupaten Banyumas, dengan informan yang terdiri atas pemerintah desa, petugas puskesmas, kader kesehatan, dan masyarakat yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling.
analysis.methods: Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, dengan analisis berfokus pada aspek komunikasi, sumber daya, disposisi, dan struktur birokrasi menurut teori George C.
analysis.main_results: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD secara umum telah berjalan cukup baik, dengan komunikasi melalui penyuluhan kesehatan dan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), serta dukungan sumber daya berupa tenaga kesehatan, kader, fasilitas, dan anggaran meskipun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana dan partisipasi masyarakat.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Penelitian ini menginterpretasikan bahwa implementasi kebijakan berjalan cukup baik dengan didukungnya disposisi pelaksana melalui komitmen dan struktur birokrasi yang jelas, namun mengidentifikasi adanya faktor penghambat seperti rendahnya partisipasi sebagian masyarakat dan keterbatasan tenaga.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations or a formal assessment of evidence strength, though the study notes constraints such as limited facilities, low community participation, and a wide surveillance area.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative descriptive study evaluated the implementation of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) control policies in Karangnanas Village, Sokaraja District, which had the highest DHF case count in 2024. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation involving village government, health center staff, health cadres, and the community. Results indicated that policy implementation was generally good regarding communication, resources, disposition, and bureaucratic structure, supported by health education and mosquito nest eradication activities. However, implementation faced barriers including low community participation, limited facilities, a wide surveillance area, and a high workload for health cadres. The study highlights the importance of cross-sector coordination and community education to improve dengue control efforts.

papers.title: Enfermedades transmitidas por vectores: chagas, dengue, malaria y hantavirus
papers.abstract: Rol estratégico de la Atención Primaria: el personal médico de familia es fundamental para el cribado inicial, el manejo ambulatorio de los casos leves y la prevención del colapso hospitalario. Alta sospecha clínica: el diagnóstico inicial se fundamenta en vincular un síndrome febril inespecífico con un nexo epidemiológico claro (viajes recientes, picaduras o exposición a roedores/brotes cerrados). Identificación de «banderas rojas»: es prioritario reconocer los signos de alarma (como sangrado de mucosas, dolor abdominal intenso, compromiso respiratorio o descompensación cardíaca) para garantizar una derivación hospitalaria inmediata y oportuna. Acción comunitaria: la educación para el control del vector y la notificación epidemiológica son pilares indelegables en el abordaje integral desde el centro de salud.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to highlight the role of primary care in the early detection and management of dengue virus-related diseases, addressing the need for timely intervention to prevent severe complications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on dengue virus and its associated infections, examining the clinical and epidemiological practices in primary care settings across various regions.
analysis.methods: The methods included identifying clinical syndromes linked to dengue virus, assessing epidemiological connections, and evaluating the importance of recognizing specific warning signs for prompt hospital referral.
analysis.main_results: The results emphasized the critical role of primary care in initial screening, managing mild cases, and preventing hospital overload through early recognition of severe dengue symptoms.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as novel insights into the strategic importance of primary care in dengue virus management, particularly in identifying warning signs for timely hospital referral.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform public health strategies by reinforcing the need for primary care integration in dengue virus surveillance and early intervention protocols.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on general observations and does not include detailed statistical analysis or specific experimental data, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: Prolyl hydroxylation is required for maturation and secretion of Zika virus non-structural protein 1
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne orthoflaviviruses such as Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus (DENV) have a high epidemic potential and are associated with a wide range of possible outcomes, from asymptomatic infections to severe complications. The orthoflavivirus non-structural protein 1 (NS1), which can be membrane-bound as well as secreted from the cell, plays important roles in viral replication, immune evasion and pathogenesis. To describe the interactome of ZIKV NS1, we infected Huh7 and neural progenitor cells with a recombinant ZIKV expressing FLAG-tagged NS1 and identified interacting proteins by quantitative mass spectrometry. In both cell types, multiple prolyl hydroxylases, glycosylation enzymes, ER-associated degradation proteins, and proteins involved in immunity were identified as NS1 interactors. Mass spectrometry data showed that NS1 contains potential hydroxyproline residues, suggesting that prolyl hydroxylase enzymes are involved in post-translational modification of NS1. Chemical inhibition of prolyl hydroxylases impaired NS1 intracellular trafficking and plasma membrane localization and reduced ZIKV RNA levels and titers. Mutagenesis of the proline residue at position 281 impaired NS1 secretion, although viral replication was unaffected. Moreover, substituting proline at position 267 strongly dysregulated NS1 expression and reverted to the wild-type sequence already after a single passage, suggesting that this mutation leads to severe replication defects. Our results identify prolyl hydroxylation as an essential post-translational modification of ZIKV NS1.

To describe the interactome of ZIKV NS1, we infected Huh7 and neural progenitor cells with a recombinant ZIKV expressing FLAG-tagged NS1 and identified interacting proteins by quantitative mass spectrometry. In both cell types, multiple prolyl hydroxylases, glycosylation enzymes, ER-associated degradation proteins, and proteins involved in immunity were identified as NS1 interactors. Mass spectrometry data showed that NS1 contains potential hydroxyproline residues, suggesting that prolyl hydroxylase enzymes are involved in post-translational modification of NS1. Chemical inhibition of prolyl hydroxylases impaired NS1 intracellular trafficking and plasma membrane localization and reduced ZIKV RNA levels and titers. Mutagenesis of the proline residue at position 281 impaired NS1 secretion, although viral replication was unaffected. Moreover, substituting proline at position 267 strongly dysregulated NS1 expression and reverted to the wild-type sequence already after a single passage, suggesting that this mutation leads to severe replication defects. Our results identify prolyl hydroxylation as an essential post-translational modification of ZIKV NS1.

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒正黄病毒,如寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 具有很高的流行潜力,并与多种可能的结果相关,从无症状感染到严重并发症。正黄病毒非结构蛋白 1 (NS1) 可以是膜结合的,也可以从细胞中分泌,在病毒复制、免疫逃避和 发病机制 中发挥重要作用。为了描述 ZIKV NS1 的相互作用组,我们用表达 FLAG 标签 NS1 的重组 ZIKV 感染 Huh7 和神经祖细胞,并通过定量质谱法鉴定相互作用蛋白。在这两种细胞类型中,多种脯氨酰羟化酶、糖基化酶、ER 相关降解蛋白和参与免疫的蛋白质被鉴定为 NS1 相互作用蛋白。质谱数据显示NS1含有潜在的羟脯氨酸残基,表明脯氨酰羟化酶参与了NS1的翻译后修饰。脯氨酰羟化酶的化学抑制会损害 NS1 的细胞内运输和质膜定位,并降低 ZIKV RNA 水平和滴度。281位脯氨酸残基的诱变损害了NS1的分泌,但病毒复制不受影响。此外,在第 267 位取代脯氨酸会严重失调 NS1 表达,并在单次传代后恢复为野生型序列,表明该 突变 会导致严重的复制缺陷。我们的结果确定脯氨酰羟基化是 ZIKV NS1 的重要翻译后修饰。

papers.title: Rural dengue dynamics: the interplay of climate, built environment, and agriculture in Costa Rica
papers.abstract: Dengue is one of the worlds highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengues urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue remains a high-burden arboviral disease, yet its dynamics in rural settings are understudied despite substantial rural burden. The study addresses a knowledge gap on how long-term climate, short-term weather variation, built environments, and land-use gradients interact to shape dengue transmission in rural areas.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study uses 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) dengue case data and ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data from Costa Rica. It employs a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework to analyze socio-environmental drivers of dengue risk across rural and urban districts.
analysis.methods: The authors applied Bayesian hierarchical modeling to monthly dengue case data at the district level over ten years, integrating climate and land-use variables. Temperature, precipitation, built infrastructure, and agricultural crop cover were evaluated as predictors of dengue risk.
analysis.main_results: Rural districts consistently showed higher dengue cases and incidence than urban districts over 22 years. Temperature primarily explained broad spatial patterns in urban-rural dengue distribution, while precipitation effects varied between coasts. Built infrastructure increased risk up to a plateau at higher volumes, and agricultural crop cover elevated risk at low and mid elevations but not at higher elevations.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that rural dengue risk in Costa Rica arises from climate suitability combined with baseline built infrastructure, with agriculture acting as an additional driver in specific elevations. This highlights the need to consider rural-specific socio-environmental interactions in dengue risk models.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study identifies key climatic and land-use features associated with rural dengue risk, informing targeted surveillance and intervention strategies in rural Costa Rica. It underscores the importance of integrating climate and land-use data into dengue control programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on ecological associations and modeling, limiting causal inference. Data granularity at the district level and reliance on reported cases may introduce biases, and findings may not generalize beyond Costa Rica's specific socio-environmental context.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates rural dengue dynamics in Costa Rica, addressing a critical gap in understanding how climate, built environments, and agriculture interact to drive transmission. Using 22 years of canton-level and ten years of district-level dengue case data, the authors applied Bayesian hierarchical modeling to identify key drivers of risk. Temperature primarily shaped broad spatial patterns in urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects varied between coasts. Built infrastructure increased risk up to a plateau, and agricultural crop cover elevated risk at low and mid elevations but not at higher elevations. The findings suggest that rural dengue risk results from climate suitability aligning with built infrastructure, with agriculture emerging as an additional driver. These results highlight the need for rural-specific surveillance and intervention strategies that integrate climate and land-use data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是一种高负担的虫媒病毒性疾病,尽管农村负担沉重,但其在农村地区的动态却尚未得到充分研究。该研究解决了长期气候、短期天气变化、建筑环境和土地利用梯度如何相互作用影响农村地区登革热 传播 的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了哥斯达黎加 22 年的州级 (admin-2) 登革热病例数据和 10 年的区级 (admin-3) 每月病例数据。它采用贝叶斯分层建模框架来分析农村和城市地区登革热风险的社会环境驱动因素。
elements_zh.methods: 作者将贝叶斯分层模型应用于十年来地区一级的每月登革热病例数据,整合了气候和土地利用变量。温度、降水、基础设施建设和农作物覆盖率被评估为登革热风险的预测因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 22 年来,农村地区的登革热病例和 发病率 始终高于城市地区。温度主要解释了城乡登革热分布的广泛空间模式,而降水效应因海岸而异。建成的基础设施将风险增加到更高的水平,而农作物覆盖率在低海拔和中海拔地区增加了风险,但在高海拔地区则没有。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue remains a high-burden arboviral disease, yet its dynamics in rural settings are understudied despite substantial rural burden. The study addresses a knowledge gap on how long-term climate, short-term weather variation, built environments, and land-use gradients interact to shape dengue transmission in rural areas.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study uses 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) dengue case data and ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data from Costa Rica. It employs a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework to analyze socio-environmental drivers of dengue risk across rural and urban districts.
analysis_en.methods: The authors applied Bayesian hierarchical modeling to monthly dengue case data at the district level over ten years, integrating climate and land-use variables. Temperature, precipitation, built infrastructure, and agricultural crop cover were evaluated as predictors of dengue risk.
analysis_en.main_results: Rural districts consistently showed higher dengue cases and incidence than urban districts over 22 years. Temperature primarily explained broad spatial patterns in urban-rural dengue distribution, while precipitation effects varied between coasts. Built infrastructure increased risk up to a plateau at higher volumes, and agricultural crop cover elevated risk at low and mid elevations but not at higher elevations.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that rural dengue risk in Costa Rica arises from climate suitability combined with baseline built infrastructure, with agriculture acting as an additional driver in specific elevations. This highlights the need to consider rural-specific socio-environmental interactions in dengue risk models.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study identifies key climatic and land-use features associated with rural dengue risk, informing targeted surveillance and intervention strategies in rural Costa Rica. It underscores the importance of integrating climate and land-use data into dengue control programs.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on ecological associations and modeling, limiting causal inference. Data granularity at the district level and reliance on reported cases may introduce biases, and findings may not generalize beyond Costa Rica's specific socio-environmental context.

papers.title_zh: 农村登革热动态:哥斯达黎加气候、建筑环境和农业的相互作用
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is one of the worlds highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengues urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是世界上负担最重的虫媒病毒疾病之一。尽管通常被认为是一种城市疾病,但许多地区的农村地区都面临着巨大的登革热负担。长期气候、短期天气变化、当地建筑环境和土地利用梯度对农村地区登革热动态的综合影响仍知之甚少,限制了我们预测全球变化下风险转移的能力。在这里,我们调查了哥斯达黎加的这些动态,以阐明这些相互作用的社会环境因素如何影响农村登革热 传播。我们首先使用 22 年的州级 (admin-2) 病例数据来确定农村地区的登革热病例和 发病率 始终高于城市地区。然后,利用十年来的区级 (admin-3) 每月病例数据和贝叶斯分层建模框架,我们确定了与登革热风险最密切相关的气候和土地利用特征。温度是登革热城乡分布的广泛空间模式的基础,而沿海之间的降水影响不同,反映了沿海气候区的对比,而不是城市化和水资源可用性之间的相互作用。在适宜的气候条件下,即使是适度的基础设施建设也会显着增加风险,但这种关系在建筑量较高的情况下会趋于稳定。在低海拔和中海拔农作物覆盖率较高的地区,登革热风险也较高,但在较高、较冷的海拔地区则不然。这些结果共同表明,哥斯达黎加农村登革热的高风险是由于气候适宜性与已建基础设施的基线水平一致所致,而农业可能成为农村登革热 传播 的独特驱动因素。

papers.title: Insecticide resistance in mosquitoes: Current status, mechanism, monitoring and innovative strategies for sustainable vector control.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika and yellow fever remain major public health challenges worldwide, causing millions of cases and thousands of deaths annually. Vector control has been the cornerstone of prevention strategies, with insecticides being the most commonly used intervention. However, the widespread and often indiscriminate use of insecticides has led to the emergence of insecticide resistance in the mosquito population, thereby threatening the sustainability of existing control measures. This review presents the current status of insecticide resistance, its underlying mechanisms, and global trends in resistance. The alternative vector control strategies, such as genetic modification, Wolbachia-based methods, botanical insecticides and nanotechnology-driven control measures, are also highlighted. It also explores the significance of insecticide resistance monitoring, integrated resistance management strategies and the need for new compounds with a distinct mode of action to ensure the continued effectiveness of vector control.

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对杀虫剂抗性机制、全球趋势和替代控制策略进行了全面概述,但没有详细说明具体的数据库、检索日期或研究计数。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 蚊子的杀虫剂抗性对可持续的 媒介 控制提出了重大挑战,需要综合抗性管理和具有不同作用模式的新化合物。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调需要更好地监测耐药性和制定创新策略,但没有详细说明具体的争议或方法学限制。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先事项包括实施综合抗性管理、开发具有新颖作用方式的新型杀虫剂,以及探索基因改造、基于沃尔巴克氏体的方法、植物源杀虫剂和纳米技术驱动的控制措施等替代策略。

papers.title: Arboviral Risk at Brazilian Tourist Destinations.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Brazil is a popular travel destination that experiences recurrent outbreaks of dengue, chikungunya, and yellow fever (YF), posing a significant health risk to both residents and international travellers. We aimed to identify high-risk regions for arboviral infections and develop a user-friendly, map-based resource to support clinical decision-making in travel medicine. METHODS: We analysed laboratory-confirmed cases and deaths from dengue, chikungunya, and YF reported to Brazil's national surveillance system from 2019 to 2024 (from 2015 for YF). Data were aggregated into 133 Intermediate Geographic Regions (IGRs). IGRs without a confirmed case during the studied period were excluded. A composite risk score was calculated for each IGR by combining (i) transmission duration (months with reported cases per year, score 0-12) and (ii) disease burden, based on national quartiles of monthly incidence and mortality (score 1-4). Annual scores were summed to produce risk maps for each arbovirus. High-risk IGRs (defined as the top quartile of composite score) were overlaid with popular tourist destinations to create an intuitive visual guide. RESULTS: We analysed 4.35 million dengue, 294,921 chikungunya, and 2,312 YF cases, resulting in 7,846, 565, and 794 deaths, respectively. Dengue affected all IGRs, with high-risk IGRs in the Midwest, including the Pantanal. Chikungunya was also identified in all IGRs, with high-risk IGRs in the Northeast, overlapping with popular beaches such as Recife. YF was identified in 38.3% of IGRs, notably in the Southeast, including São Paulo state. CONCLUSIONS: Arboviruses pose a diverse risk across Brazil. Our spatially integrated map provides a novel tool for travel medicine, enabling healthcare practitioners to offer tailored advice and pre-travel vaccinations to travellers.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed arboviral risks in Brazil using national surveillance data from 2019-2024 (2015 for yellow fever). Researchers aggregated 4.35 million dengue cases, 294,921 chikungunya cases, and 2,312 yellow fever cases across 133 Intermediate Geographic Regions. A composite risk score combining transmission duration and disease burden identified high-risk areas: dengue in the Midwest (including Pantanal), chikungunya in the Northeast (near Recife beaches), and yellow fever in the Southeast (São Paulo). The resulting map-based tool provides tailored travel medicine guidance, highlighting the need for region-specific pre-travel interventions. While the comprehensive dataset strengthens the findings, potential underreporting limits confidence.
