elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 巴西是一个热门的旅游目的地,该国经常出现登革热、基孔肯雅热和黄热病 (YF),给居民和国际旅行者带来重大健康风险。该研究旨在确定虫媒病毒感染的高风险区域,并开发一种用户友好的、基于地图的资源,以支持旅行医学的临床决策。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了 2019 年至 2024 年(YF 从 2015 年开始)向巴西国家 监测 系统报告的登革热、基孔肯雅热和 YF 实验室确诊病例和死亡病例。数据汇总到 133 个中间地理区域 (IGR),排除了研究期间没有确诊病例的 IGR。
elements_zh.methods: 根据每月 发病率 和 死亡率(分数 1-4)的国家四分位数,结合 (i) 传播 持续时间(每年报告病例的月数,分数 0-12)和 (ii) 疾病负担,计算每个 IGR 的综合风险分数。将年度得分相加,生成每种虫媒病毒的风险地图,并将高风险 IGR(定义为综合得分的前四分之一)与热门旅游目的地重叠,以创建直观的视觉指南。
elements_zh.main_results: We analysed 4.35 million dengue, 294,921 chikungunya, and 2,312 YF cases, resulting in 7,846, 565, and 794 deaths, respectively. Dengue affected all IGRs, with high-risk IGRs in the Midwest, including the Pantanal. Chikungunya was also identified in all IGRs, with high-risk IGRs in the Northeast, overlapping with popular beaches such as Recife. YF was identified in 38.3% of IGRs, notably in the Southeast, including São Paulo state.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虫媒病毒在巴西各地构成多种风险。我们的空间集成地图为旅行医学提供了一种新颖的工具,使医疗保健从业者能够向旅行者提供量身定制的建议和旅行前 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为前往巴西高风险地区的游客提供有针对性的 监测 和旅行前 疫苗接种 策略,特别是中西部的登革热和东北部的基孔肯雅热。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于 监测 数据,该数据可能漏报病例,风险评分方法虽然具有创新性,但尚未经过外部验证。由于国家数据集全面,证据强度中等,但受到潜在报告偏差的限制。

analysis_zh.methods: 根据每月 发病率 和 死亡率(分数 1-4)的国家四分位数,结合 (i) 传播 持续时间(每年报告病例的月数,分数 0-12)和 (ii) 疾病负担,计算每个 IGR 的综合风险分数。将年度得分相加,生成每种虫媒病毒的风险地图,并将高风险 IGR(定义为综合得分的前四分之一)与热门旅游目的地重叠,以创建直观的视觉指南。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虫媒病毒在巴西各地构成多种风险。我们的空间集成地图为旅行医学提供了一种新颖的工具,使医疗保健从业者能够向旅行者提供量身定制的建议和旅行前 疫苗接种。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为前往巴西高风险地区的游客提供有针对性的 监测 和旅行前 疫苗接种 策略,特别是中西部的登革热和东北部的基孔肯雅热。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于 监测 数据,该数据可能漏报病例,风险评分方法虽然具有创新性,但尚未经过外部验证。由于国家数据集全面,证据强度中等,但受到潜在报告偏差的限制。

papers.title: A New Method to Predict the Effect of an Intervention in the Host Population to Reduce the Magnitude of an Outbreak of a Vector-Borne Infection
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a new model to estimate the impact of an intervention on human hosts of a vector-borne infection, such as dengue, which occurs in yearly outbreaks of different magnitudes. The model applies to these outbreaks and, in fact, is independent of their intensity, that is, it does not require the steady-state assumption. The model takes as input the officially reported age-dependent number of cases of a vector-borne infection. It is deterministic and does not account for stochasticity. Our objective is to estimate the impact of the intervention (the efficacy), and we rely on the observed fact that the age distribution of the proportion of cases of the infections transmitted by the same vector is independent of both the intensity of transmission and the geographic area studied, at least for Brazilian regions. This finding is highlighted in the main text and forms the basis of our calculations. A hypothetical intervention is simulated using a dengue vaccine, which allows the determination of the optimal strategy for a vaccination campaign.

analysis.summary_en: This paper introduces a new deterministic model to estimate the impact of interventions, such as vaccination, on vector-borne infections like dengue. The model uses age-dependent case data and is independent of outbreak intensity, making it applicable to varying magnitudes of yearly outbreaks. By leveraging the consistent age distribution of cases across transmission intensities and Brazilian regions, the model simulates interventions to determine optimal strategies. While it provides a novel approach for outbreak control, its deterministic nature limits its ability to account for stochasticity. The findings have significant implications for designing targeted vaccination campaigns, though the evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on observational data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该模型适用于 媒介 传播的感染的 暴发,并且与其强度无关,不需要稳态假设。
elements_zh.methods: 确定性模型使用官方报告的年龄相关病例数作为输入,并模拟假设的干预措施(例如登革热 疫苗),以确定最佳 疫苗接种 策略。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型不考虑随机性,而是依赖于观察到的病例年龄分布与巴西地区 传播 强度和地理区域的独立性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将该模型解释为一种估计干预效果的新工具,利用不同 传播 强度和区域的病例的一致年龄分布。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对登革热等 媒介 传播感染的有针对性的 疫苗接种 活动的设计提供信息,从而有可能优化 暴发 控制策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该模型的确定性性质限制了其解释随机变异性的能力,并且由于依赖观察数据且缺乏随机建模,证据强度中等。

papers.title: House modifications using insecticide-treated screening of eave and window as a vector control tool: evidence from a semi-field system in Tanzania and simulated epidemiological impact.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Gaps in unimproved house structures, especially in eaves and windows, allow mosquito entry, increasing indoor vector-borne disease transmission. Simple modifications to such houses may reduce human exposure, and insecticide treatment may kill mosquitoes, benefiting all community members. This study evaluated insecticide-treated screening (ITS) for eaves and windows, incorporated with deltamethrin and piperonyl butoxide (PBO), compared to a permethrin and PBO-treated bednet in Tanzania. METHOD: A randomised Latin-square design (4 × 4) was used in four experimental huts within a large netting cage to allow mosquito recapture inside and outside of huts. Four treatments were evaluated: (1) new (12-month stored) ITS; (2) 12-month naturally-aged ITS; (3) 12-month field-used pyrethroid-PBO bednet (standard of care in Tanzania), and (4) no treatment. The study was performed for 32 nights using 30 mosquitoes per strain, per hut per night. Four laboratory-reared strains were used: malaria vectors (Anopheles arabiensis and An. funestus), dengue vector (Aedes aegypti), and nuisance biting (Culex quinquefasciatus). Recaptured mosquitoes were assessed for mortality at 72 h, blood-feeding, and hut entry. A simulation with a modified mechanistic model tracking Plasmodium falciparum malaria was used to illustrate potential epidemiological impact from these products. RESULTS: Against all mosquito species compared to 12-month aged pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednet, new ITS induced higher mortality [Odds Ratio:2.25(95%Confidence Interval:1.65-3.06),p < 0.0001], and aged-ITS was similar [OR:0.80(95%CI:0.59-1.08),p = 0.141]. Both new and aged ITS significantly (p < 0.0001) reduced mosquito blood-feeding [new OR:0.02(95% CI:0.01-0.03); aged OR:0.09(95%CI:0.05-0.14)] and hut entry [new IRR:0.10(95%CI:0.08-0.13); aged IRR:0.25(95%CI:0.21-0.31)]. Transmission model estimates indicate epidemiological impacts of ITS may supersede pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednets at the population level. The model results indicate impact potency depends on assumed intervention percentage cover, durability, and mosquito bionomics. CONCLUSIONS: This study introduces a standardised semi-field bioassay to evaluate ITS, generating entomological data that, for the first time, enabled modelling of its potential impact on malaria transmission. ITS is an efficacious tool for public health as it kills substantial proportions of malaria and dengue vectors, and reduces nuisance biting. Given its simplicity, it should be considered an additional or stand-alone tool for screening unimproved houses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 未改进的房屋结构中的间隙,特别是屋檐和窗户中的间隙,允许蚊子进入,增加室内 媒介 传播的疾病 传播。对此类房屋进行简单改造可以减少人类接触,杀虫剂 治疗 可以杀死蚊子,使所有社区成员受益。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在大型网笼内的四个实验小屋​​中使用了随机拉丁方设计(4×4),以便在小屋内外重新捕获蚊子。该研究进行了 32 个晚上,每间小屋每晚使用 30 只蚊子。使用四种实验室饲养的菌株:疟疾 媒介(阿拉伯按蚊和按蚊)、登革热 媒介(埃及伊蚊)和滋扰库蚊(Culex quinquefasciatus)。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究评估了经杀虫剂处理的屋檐和窗户纱网 (ITS),并与坦桑尼亚经氯菊酯和 PBO 处理的蚊帐进行了比较,并与溴氰菊酯和胡椒基丁醚 (PBO) 进行了比较。评估了四个 治疗:(1)新的(存储 12 个月的)ITS;(2) 12个月自然老化的ITS;(3) 12 个月现场使用的拟除虫菊酯-PBO 蚊帐(坦桑尼亚的护理标准),以及 (4) 无 治疗。重新捕获的蚊子在 72 小时、吸血和进入小屋时进行 死亡率 评估。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究引入了一种标准化的半场生物测定法来评估 ITS,生成昆虫学数据,首次能够对其对疟疾 传播 的潜在影响进行建模。ITS 是公共卫生的有效工具,因为它可以杀死大部分疟疾和登革热 媒介,并减少令人讨厌的叮咬。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于其简单性,ITS 应被视为筛查未改良房屋的附加或独立工具。传播 模型估计表明,ITS 的流行病学影响可能会取代拟除虫菊酯 - PBO 处理的蚊帐在人口水平上的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 模型结果表明影响效力取决于假设的干预覆盖率、持久性和蚊子生物学特性。由于半现场系统设计和对模拟流行病学影响的依赖,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 本研究评估了经杀虫剂处理的屋檐和窗户纱网 (ITS),并与坦桑尼亚经氯菊酯和 PBO 处理的蚊帐进行了比较,并与溴氰菊酯和胡椒基丁醚 (PBO) 进行了比较。评估了四个 治疗:(1)新的(存储 12 个月的)ITS;(2) 12个月自然老化的ITS;(3) 12 个月现场使用的拟除虫菊酯-PBO 蚊帐(坦桑尼亚的护理标准),以及 (4) 无 治疗。重新捕获的蚊子在 72 小时、吸血和进入小屋时进行 死亡率 评估。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究引入了一种标准化的半场生物测定法来评估 ITS,生成昆虫学数据,首次能够对其对疟疾 传播 的潜在影响进行建模。ITS 是公共卫生的有效工具,因为它可以杀死大部分疟疾和登革热 媒介,并减少令人讨厌的叮咬。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于其简单性,ITS 应被视为筛查未改良房屋的附加或独立工具。传播 模型估计表明,ITS 的流行病学影响可能会取代拟除虫菊酯 - PBO 处理的蚊帐在人口水平上的影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 模型结果表明影响效力取决于假设的干预覆盖率、持久性和蚊子生物学特性。由于半现场系统设计和对模拟流行病学影响的依赖,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Evaluation of Escherichia coli-derived Silver Nanoparticles for Aedes Vector Control in Southern India.
papers.abstract: Background Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are the principal mosquito vectors in Tamil Nadu transmitting the major arboviral diseases such as Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika and Yellow Fever. Aedes aegypti serves as the primary vector, followed by Aedes albopictus. Due to the limitations and environmental concerns associated with predictable chemical larvicides, there is an emergency need for alternative and sustainable vector control strategies. Methods In this study, environmentally friendly silver nanoparticles were synthesized using Escherichia coli through a biogenic approach that develops the bacterium's naturally reducing and stabilizing properties. The synthesized silver nanoparticles were characterized for size, shape, and stability using UV-Visible spectroscopy and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. The larvicidal efficacy of silver nanoparticles was evaluated against the larvae of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus from the Thiruvarur district of Tamil Nadu, India. LC 50 and LC 90 values were estimated using probit analysis according to Finney's method (Miller-Tainter approach) in SPSS. Results The biosynthesized silver nanoparticles showed strong larvicidal activity against both mosquito species, depending on the dose approach, the moderate larval mortality was observed in Aedes albopictus than in Aedes aegypti. The median lethal concentration (LC 50 ) was estimated at 270 ± 16 mg/L for Aedes aegypti and 194 ± 13 mg/L for Aedes albopictus, and LC 90 values were estimated at 3480 ± 490 mg/L for Aedes aegypti and 2510 ± 360 mg/L for Aedes albopictus. The findings indicate that the biogenically synthesized silver nanoparticles are an effective alternative to chemical larvicides, offering enhanced efficacy with reduced environment impact. Conclusion The current study highlights the dual advantages of utilizing biological resources for nanoparticle synthesis and implementing sustainable approaches for the control of mosquito- borne diseases. Future research should focus on large-scale production, field-level efficacy assessments, and evaluation of potential effects on non-target organisms to support practical applications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊是泰米尔纳德邦传播登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等主要虫媒病毒疾病的主要蚊子 媒介。由于可预测的化学杀幼虫剂的局限性和环境问题,迫切需要替代和可持续的 媒介 控制策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了银纳米粒子对印度泰米尔纳德邦蒂鲁瓦鲁尔地区埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊幼虫的杀幼虫功效。该研究利用大肠杆菌通过生物方法合成的环保银纳米颗粒。
elements_zh.methods: 使用紫外-可见光谱和傅里叶变换红外(FTIR)光谱对合成的银纳米颗粒的尺寸、形状和稳定性进行了表征。LC 50 和LC 90 值根据SPSS中的Finney法(Miller-Tainter法)使用概率分析来估计。
elements_zh.main_results: 生物合成的银纳米粒子对两种蚊子均表现出很强的杀幼虫活性,在白纹伊蚊中观察到的幼虫 死亡率 程度高于埃及伊蚊。埃及伊蚊的半数致死浓度 (LC 50) 估计为 270 ± 16 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的半数致死浓度为 194 ± 13 mg/L。埃及伊蚊的 LC 90 值估计为 3480 ± 490 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的 LC 90 值估计为 2510 ± 360 mg/L。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,生物合成的银纳米颗粒是化学杀幼虫剂的有效替代品,可提高功效并减少对环境的影响。目前的研究强调了利用生物资源合成纳米颗粒和实施可持续方法控制蚊媒疾病的双重优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 未来的研究应侧重于大规模生产、现场功效评估以及对非目标生物体的潜在影响的评估,以支持实际应用。该研究提出了与受登革热等虫媒病毒性疾病影响的地区相关的可持续 媒介 控制策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素。证据强度被评估为中等,因为数据仅来自摘要,缺乏详细的方法描述和完整的结果。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊是泰米尔纳德邦传播登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等主要虫媒病毒疾病的主要蚊子 媒介。埃及伊蚊是主要的 媒介,其次是白纹伊蚊。由于可预测的化学杀幼虫剂的局限性和环境问题,迫切需要替代和可持续的 媒介 控制策略。方法在这项研究中,利用大肠杆菌通过生物方法合成了环保的银纳米颗粒,该方法开发了细菌的自然还原和稳定特性。使用紫外-可见光谱和傅里叶变换红外(FTIR)光谱对合成的银纳米颗粒的尺寸、形状和稳定性进行了表征。针对印度泰米尔纳德邦蒂鲁瓦鲁尔地区的埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊幼虫,评估了银纳米粒子的杀幼虫功效。LC 50 和LC 90 值根据SPSS中的Finney法(Miller-Tainter法)使用概率分析来估计。结果生物合成的纳米银颗粒对两种蚊子均表现出较强的杀幼虫活性,根据剂量方法,在白纹伊蚊中观察到的幼虫死亡率较埃及伊蚊为中等。埃及伊蚊的半致死浓度 (LC 50 ) 估计为 270 ± 16 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的半致死浓度为 194 ± 13 mg/L,埃及伊蚊的半致死浓度 (LC 50 ) 估计为 3480 ± 490 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的 LC 90 值估计为 2510 ± 360 mg/L。研究结果表明,生物合成的银纳米颗粒是化学杀幼虫剂的有效替代品,可提高功效并减少对环境的影响。结论 当前的研究强调了利用生物资源合成纳米颗粒和实施可持续方法控制蚊媒疾病的双重优势。未来的研究应侧重于大规模生产、现场功效评估以及对非目标生物体的潜在影响的评估,以支持实际应用。

papers.title: Complex Multisystem Medical Presentations Managed in a Secondary Care General Medicine Unit: A CARE-Compliant Case Series from Southern India
papers.abstract: Structured AbstractBackgroundGeneral medicine departments frequently encounter patients presenting with overlapping infectious, metabolic, cardiovascular, renal, respiratory, and autoimmune disorders. Such patients often require multidisciplinary management and individualized treatment strategies.ObjectiveTo describe the clinical characteristics, investigations, management approaches, and outcomes of a series of complex medical cases admitted to a secondary care hospital in Southern India.MethodsA retrospective observational case series was conducted using hospital records of nine patients admitted between May 2026 and June 2026 under the Department of General Medicine. Data regarding demographics, presenting symptoms, comorbidities, diagnostic investigations, therapeutic interventions, multidisciplinary involvement, and clinical outcomes were extracted and analyzed descriptively.ResultsThe case series included severe bronchopneumonia with respiratory failure (n=2), methotrexate-induced pancytopenia with diabetic ketoacidosis (n=1), viral fever with inflammatory polyarthritis (n=1), dengue fever with thrombocytopenia and hepatic dysfunction (n=1), infective myocarditis (n=1), acute kidney injury with urinary retention (n=1), obstructive uropathy secondary to bladder carcinoma (n=1), urosepsis (n=1), and necrotizing fasciitis with sepsis (n=1). Diabetes mellitus was the most frequent comorbidity. Intensive care support was required in five patients. Multidisciplinary care resulted in favorable outcomes in eight patients, while one patient required continued specialist follow-up for malignancy-related disease.ConclusionThis case series highlights the broad clinical spectrum encountered in general medicine practice and emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis, multidisciplinary collaboration, and individualized management in improving outcomes in complex medical patients.

analysis.research_question_and_background: General medicine departments frequently encounter patients with overlapping infectious, metabolic, cardiovascular, renal, respiratory, and autoimmune disorders who require multidisciplinary management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective observational case series was conducted using hospital records of nine patients admitted between May 2026 and June 2026 to a secondary care hospital in Southern India.
analysis.methods: Data regarding demographics, presenting symptoms, comorbidities, diagnostic investigations, therapeutic interventions, multidisciplinary involvement, and clinical outcomes were extracted and analyzed descriptively.
analysis.main_results: The series included one case of dengue fever with thrombocytopenia and hepatic dysfunction, alongside other conditions such as severe bronchopneumonia and methotrexate-induced pancytopenia; diabetes mellitus was the most frequent comorbidity and intensive care support was required in five patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as highlighting the broad clinical spectrum encountered in general medicine practice and emphasize the importance of early diagnosis, multidisciplinary collaboration, and individualized management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that multidisciplinary care can result in favorable outcomes for complex medical patients in secondary care settings, though specific implications for dengue prevention or control are not detailed.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is low due to the retrospective, observational design of a small case series (n=9) from a single center, which limits generalizability and the ability to establish causal relationships.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective observational case series describes the clinical characteristics and outcomes of nine complex medical patients admitted to a secondary care hospital in Southern India between May and June 2026. The cases encompassed a range of severe conditions, including one instance of dengue fever with thrombocytopenia and hepatic dysfunction, as well as severe bronchopneumonia and methotrexate-induced pancytopenia. Diabetes mellitus was identified as the most frequent comorbidity, and five patients required intensive care support. The authors report that multidisciplinary care resulted in favorable outcomes for eight patients, emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis and individualized management strategies. However, the evidence strength is low due to the small sample size and single-center design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 全科医学科经常遇到患有重叠感染、代谢、心血管、肾脏、呼吸和自身免疫性疾病的患者,需要多学科治疗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2026 年 5 月至 2026 年 6 月期间在印度南部一家二级保健医院收治的 9 名患者的医院记录进行了回顾性观察病例系列。
elements_zh.methods: 提取有关人口统计、症状、合并症、诊断调查、治疗干预、多学科参与和临床结果的数据并进行描述性分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 该系列包括一例伴有血小板减少和肝功能障碍的 登革热 病例,以及严重支气管肺炎和甲氨蝶呤引起的全血细胞减少等其他病症;糖尿病是最常见的合并症,五名患者需要重症监护支持。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调了普通医学实践中遇到的广泛临床范围,并强调了早期 诊断、多学科合作和个体化管理的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,多学科护理可以为二级护理机构中的复杂医疗患者带来有利的结果,尽管对登革热预防或控制的具体影响尚未详细说明。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于来自单个中心的小病例系列(n = 9)的回顾性观察设计,证据强度较低,这限制了普遍性和建立因果关系的能力。

papers.title: Ocular Involvement in Systemic Infections: An Overview of Clinical Manifestations
papers.abstract: Infectious diseases constitute a major public health concern and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. The eye, by virtue of its rich vascularity and unique immunological microenvironment, is susceptible to involvement by a broad spectrum of bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic systemic infections, which may lead to diverse ocular and visual manifestations through direct pathogen invasion, immune-mediated mechanisms, or complications of therapy. Notable systemic infections with potential ocular involvement include tuberculosis; the spirochetal illnesses syphilis, Lyme disease, and leptospirosis; brucellosis; cat-scratch disease; leprosy; infective endocarditis; human immunodeficiency virus, cytomegalovirus, West Nile virus, and adenovirus infections; rubeola; dengue fever; candidiasis; cryptococcosis; aspergillosis; mucormycosis; toxoplasmosis; malaria; onchocerciasis; and cysticercosis. Ocular manifestations can serve as early diagnostic clues to underlying systemic infections, whereas, conversely, systemic features can help interpret ocular findings. Effective investigation and management of systemic infections benefit from a multidisciplinary approach, in which ophthalmologists can contribute substantially and help optimize both visual and overall health outcomes.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on ocular involvement in systemic infections, with a particular emphasis on dengue virus. analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that ocular manifestations can serve as early diagnostic clues for systemic infections, including dengue virus. papers.title: A hierarchical clock-mixture model for Bayesian phylogenetic dating
papers.abstract: Conditioning the inference of a Bayesian phylogenetic time tree on a single molecular clock model treats clock choice as fixed, even when support among plausible clock families is uncertain. When that assumption is wrong, estimated timescales and their uncertainty can be distorted. Existing practice usually addresses this by fitting strict, uncorrelated lognormal relaxed (UCLN), and autocorrelated clocks separately and comparing their marginal likelihoods, but this requires multiple computationally expensive model selection analyses.Here we introduce a hierarchical clock-mixture framework, implemented as the open-source \texttt{RelaxClockAveraging} package for BEAST~2, that separates two questions that are often conflated in clock comparison: whether branch-specific rate variation is needed at all, and, if it is, whether that variation is better described as uncorrelated or autocorrelated. The method averages analytically between strict and relaxed clocks at the top level and then compares UCLN and autocorrelated models within the relaxed class on a shared branch-rate vector, returning posterior probabilities for all three clock families together with model-averaged summaries for parameters shared across them. In stratified simulations, the generating clock family was retained in the 95\% posterior model set in all replicates, while model-averaged estimates of the overall substitution rate, root age, and tree length remained accurate. On a DENV-4 benchmark, the mixture reproduced the higher-effort nested-sampling ranking of clock families while avoiding the extreme run-to-run variability of independent marginal-likelihood estimates. On empirical benchmarks, the method recovered strong support for the autocorrelated clock on the classical 31-taxon chloroplast \textit{rbcL} data set. On an RSV-A G-gene data set it concentrated virtually all posterior support on UCLN while preserving the established RSV-A timescale. On a 245-taxon structured-coalescent H3N2 dataset it assigned most posterior mass to the relaxed-clock class, with support within that class concentrated on the autocorrelated family, and the inferred timescale remained consistent with the published estimate. These results show that clock-model support and downstream timescale sensitivity are related but not identical. Single-clock dating analyses can still be adequate, but fixing a clock model should be justified by posterior support rather than treated as a default assumption.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a hierarchical clock-mixture framework for Bayesian phylogenetic dating that addresses the problem of conditioning inference on a single molecular clock model, which can distort timescales and uncertainty when support among clock families is uncertain. The method, implemented as the RelaxClockAveraging package for BEAST 2, analytically averages between strict and relaxed clocks and compares uncorrelated and autocorrelated models within the relaxed class, returning posterior probabilities for all three clock families. Existing practice usually addresses this by fitting strict, uncorrelated lognormal relaxed (UCLN), and autocorrelated clocks separately and comparing their marginal likelihoods, but this requires multiple computationally expensive model selection analyses.Here we introduce a hierarchical clock-mixture framework, implemented as the open-source \texttt{RelaxClockAveraging} package for BEAST~2, that separates two questions that are often conflated in clock comparison: whether branch-specific rate variation is needed at all, and, if it is, whether that variation is better described as uncorrelated or autocorrelated. The method averages analytically between strict and relaxed clocks at the top level and then compares UCLN and autocorrelated models within the relaxed class on a shared branch-rate vector, returning posterior probabilities for all three clock families together with model-averaged summaries for parameters shared across them. In stratified simulations, the generating clock family was retained in the 95\% posterior model set in all replicates, while model-averaged estimates of the overall substitution rate, root age, and tree length remained accurate. On a DENV-4 benchmark, the mixture reproduced the higher-effort nested-sampling ranking of clock families while avoiding the extreme run-to-run variability of independent marginal-likelihood estimates. On empirical benchmarks, the method recovered strong support for the autocorrelated clock on the classical 31-taxon chloroplast \textit{rbcL} data set. On an RSV-A G-gene data set it concentrated virtually all posterior support on UCLN while preserving the established RSV-A timescale. On a 245-taxon structured-coalescent H3N2 dataset it assigned most posterior mass to the relaxed-clock class, with support within that class concentrated on the autocorrelated family, and the inferred timescale remained consistent with the published estimate. These results show that clock-model support and downstream timescale sensitivity are related but not identical. Single-clock dating analyses can still be adequate, but fixing a clock model should be justified by posterior support rather than treated as a default assumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 在单一分子钟模型条件下推断贝叶斯系统发育时间树,将钟的选择视为固定的,即使在合理的钟家族之间的支持是不确定的。当该假设错误时,估计的时间尺度及其不确定性可能会被扭曲。现有的做法通常通过分别拟合严格、不相关对数正态松弛(UCLN)和自相关钟并比较它们的边际似然来解决这个问题,但这需要多次计算昂贵的模型选择分析。在这里,我们介绍了一个分层钟混合框架,作为 BEAST~2 的开源 \texttt{RelaxClockAveraging} 包实现,它分离了在钟比较中经常混淆的两个问题:是否根本需要分支特异性速率变化,以及如果需要,该变化是否更好地描述为不相关或自相关。该方法在顶层在严格钟和松弛钟之间进行解析平均,然后在松弛类别内共享的分支速率 媒介 上比较 UCLN 和自相关模型,返回所有三个钟家族的后验概率以及它们之间共享参数的模型平均汇总。在分层模拟中,生成的钟家族在所有重复中都被保留在 95\% 后验模型集中,而整体替换率、根年龄和树长的模型平均估计保持准确。在 DENV-4 基准测试中,该混合模型重现了钟家族的更高努力嵌套采样排名,同时避免了独立边际似然估计的极端运行间变异性。在经验基准测试中,该方法在经典的 31 个分类单元叶绿体 \textit{rbcL} 数据集上恢复了对自相关钟的强有力支持。在一个 RSV-A G 基因数据集上,它几乎将所有后验支持集中在 UCLN 上,同时保持了既定的 RSV-A 时间尺度。在一个包含 245 个分类单元的结构化合并 H3N2 数据集上,它将大部分后验质量分配给松弛钟类别,该类别内的支持集中在自相关家族上,推断的时间尺度与已发表的估计保持一致。这些结果表明,钟模型支持和下游时间尺度敏感性是相关但不相同的。单钟定年分析可能仍然足够,但固定钟模型应由后验支持证明,而不是被视为默认假设。

papers.title: MicroRNA Regulation of Aedes aegypti Infected with Three Different Pathogens: The Role of aae-miR-375 in Targeting bre-4 to Modulate Mosquito Immunity.
papers.abstract: Aedes aegypti is an important vector of human pathogens, including dengue and chikungunya viruses. We examined midgut miRNA expression changes in Ae. aegypti following infection with Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Beauveria bassiana. We identified 19 differentially expressed miRNAs in the midgut of fourth-instar larvae infected with E. coli, 42 in larvae infected with S. aureus, and 134 in adult mosquitoes. The highest number of differentially expressed miRNAs (160) was observed in mosquitoes infected with B. Among these, aae-miR-375 showed the most pronounced change, with nearly 96% downregulation after S. The interaction between aae-miR-375 and Ae-bre-4 was validated using dual-luciferase assays. These results indicate that different pathogens induce distinct midgut miRNA expression profiles in Ae. Furthermore, we identified Ae-bre-4 as a target of aae-miR-375, providing new insights into the pathogen-miRNA-mRNA interactions that underlie mosquito immune responses. Collectively, these findings improve our understanding of mosquito immunity and may inform future vector control strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the role of microRNA in modulating mosquito immunity in response to dengue virus infection, as Aedes aegypti is a key vector for dengue and other human pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined midgut miRNA expression changes in Aedes aegypti following infection with Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Beauveria bassiana, with a focus on dengue virus-related immune responses.
analysis.methods: The researchers used dual-luciferase assays to validate the interaction between aae-miR-375 and Ae-bre-4, and analyzed miRNA expression profiles in fourth-instar larvae and adult mosquitoes.
analysis.main_results: The study identified 19 differentially expressed miRNAs in larvae infected with Escherichia coli, 42 in larvae infected with Staphylococcus aureus, and 134 in adult mosquitoes. The highest number of differentially expressed miRNAs (160) was observed in mosquitoes infected with Beauveria bassiana. Among these, aae-miR-375 showed the most pronounced change, with nearly 96% downregulation after Staphylococcus aureus infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that different pathogens induce distinct midgut miRNA expression profiles in Aedes aegypti, and that aae-miR-375 interacts with Ae-bre-4, providing new insights into the molecular mechanisms of mosquito immune responses to pathogens.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform future vector control strategies by highlighting the role of miRNA in mosquito immunity and its potential as a target for interventions against dengue virus and other pathogens.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level evidence and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental validation beyond dual-luciferase assays, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of microRNA in modulating Aedes aegypti immunity following infection with various pathogens, including Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Beauveria bassiana. The researchers identified differentially expressed miRNAs in the midgut of larvae and adult mosquitoes, with aae-miR-375 showing the most significant change. They validated the interaction between aae-miR-375 and Ae-bre-4 using dual-luciferase assays, suggesting that miRNA regulation plays a key role in mosquito immune responses. The findings may contribute to understanding vector immunity and inform future strategies for controlling dengue virus and other pathogens. However, the study is based on abstract-level evidence and lacks detailed statistical or experimental validation, limiting the confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究 microRNA 在调节蚊子免疫力以应对 登革病毒 感染中的作用,因为埃及伊蚊是登革热和其他人类病原体的关键 媒介。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检测了埃及伊蚊感染大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和白僵菌后中肠 miRNA 表达的变化,重点是 登革病毒 相关的 免疫应答。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用双荧光素酶测定来验证 aae-miR-375 和 Ae-bre-4 之间的相互作用,并分析了四龄幼虫和成年蚊子中的 miRNA 表达谱。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究在感染大肠杆菌的幼虫中鉴定出 19 种差异表达的 miRNA,在感染金黄色葡萄球菌的幼虫中鉴定出 42 种差异表达的 miRNA,在成年蚊子中鉴定出 134 种差异表达的 miRNA。在感染白僵菌的蚊子中观察到差异表达 miRNA 的数量最多 (160)。其中,aae-miR-375表现出最明显的变化,在金黄色葡萄球菌感染后下调了近96%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,不同的病原体在埃及伊蚊中诱导不同的中肠 miRNA 表达谱,并且 aae-miR-375 与 Ae-bre-4 相互作用,为蚊子 免疫应答 对病原体的分子机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能通过强调 miRNA 在蚊子免疫中的作用及其作为 登革病毒 和其他病原体干预目标的潜力,为未来的 媒介 控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象水平的证据,除了双荧光素酶测定之外,没有提供详细的统计分析或实验验证,导致研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.title: Exploitation of host U2AF1 and U2AF2 splicing factors facilitates mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus infection across species
papers.abstract: Abstract To identify novel host factors essential for orthoflavivirus replication, we performed proteomic profiling of endoplasmic reticulum fractions isolated from cells infected with Dengue virus or Zika virus (ZIKV). Among the enriched proteins, the splicing factor U2AF2 and its heterodimeric partner U2AF1 were found to be critical for efficient viral infection, functioning at the viral protein synthesis stage. The arginine/serine-rich (RS) domain and the first zinc knuckle (Zn1) of U2AF1, as well as nearly all domains except the RS domain of U2AF2, were essential for their proviral function. Disruption of the U2AF1–U2AF2 interaction potently suppressed ZIKV infection. U2AF1 and U2AF2 partially localize to the cytoplasm, and notably, the cytoplasmic U2AF2 was predominantly a truncated form that was sufficient to support viral replication. Both U2AF1 and U2AF2 bind to viral RNA, with U2AF1 binding being dependent on U2AF2. Interestingly, trans-complementation of the Aedes aegypti homolog u2af38 into U2AF1-knockout cells restored ZIKV replication, whereas expressing u2af50 in U2AF2-knockdown cells did not. However, knockdown of either u2af38 or u2af50 significantly inhibited the flavivirus replication in mosquitoes. Together, these findings reveal that flaviviruses co-opt host splicing factors in both human cells and mosquitoes, underscoring a conserved cross-species mechanism of viral exploitation.

papers.title: Comparison of Oviposition and Adult Trapping to Monitor wMel Introgression for Wolbachia-Based Vector Control.
papers.abstract: Wolbachia introgression into Aedes aegypti (Ae. aegypti) mosquito populations is an effective strategy for preventing dengue and is currently under evaluation for WHO prequalification. The standard protocol for trials and deployments currently being conducted in Brazil by the World Mosquito Program (WMP) for long-term monitoring of Wolbachia introgression involves the use of BG-Sentinel traps (BG-traps; Biogents AG [Regensburg, Germany]), which are labor-intensive and costly. More affordable alternatives, such as oviposition traps (ovitraps), have been used in other settings; however, a comparison of the WMP protocol for Wolbachia surveillance has not been performed. As part of the EVITA dengue trial, Ae. aegypti eggs and adults were collected from 124 ovitraps and 237 BG-traps across 12 clusters in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, between March and May 2023. Eggs collected from ovitraps were reared to L3 and L4 larvae, and wMel Wolbachia was detected using quantitative polymerase chain reaction testing in larvae and adult mosquitoes from BG-traps. Mixed-effects models were used to compare cluster-level estimates of wMel introgression derived from ovitrap and BG-trap data over time. Among 3,675 larvae reared from ovitraps, wMel prevalence was 0.50 (95% CI: 0.48-0.51), whereas 1,244 adults from BG-traps had a prevalence of 0.45 (95% CI: 0.42-0.48). analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of oviposition traps (ovitraps) as an alternative to BG-Sentinel traps for monitoring Wolbachia introgression in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The authors concluded that ovitrap-based surveillance offers a low-resource, efficient, and precise alternative for monitoring Wolbachia introgression in high-burden dengue settings. The study's findings are significant for improving surveillance methods but are limited to abstract-only evidence, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估监测埃及伊蚊沃尔巴克氏体渗入的替代方法,这是预防登革热的关键策略。背景强调基于沃尔巴克氏体的 媒介 控制是预防登革热的有效策略,目前正在接受世界卫生组织资格预审评估。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2023 年 3 月至 5 月在巴西贝洛奥里藏特进行,涉及 12 个集群中的 124 个产卵诱集器和 237 个 BG 诱集器。从这些诱捕器中收集埃及伊蚊卵和成虫以评估沃尔巴克氏体渗入。
elements_zh.methods: 从产卵器收集的卵被培育成 L3 和 L4 幼虫,并使用定量聚合酶链反应测试在 BG 陷阱的幼虫和成蚊中检测到沃尔巴克氏体 (wMel)。混合效应模型用于比较从产卵器和 BG 陷阱数据随时间推移得出的 wMel 渗入的簇水平估计。
elements_zh.main_results: 在产卵器饲养的 3,675 只幼虫中,wMel 患病率 为 0.50(95% CI:0.48-0.51),而 BG 诱捕器饲养的 1,244 只成虫的 患病率 为 0.45(95% CI:0.42-0.48)。幼虫和成虫的簇级渗入估计值密切相关(Spearman's r = 0.70;P <0.001)。结合当前和上个月产卵器数据和蚊子丰度的多变量模型显示,基于产卵器的预测与 BG 陷阱估计值之间具有很强的一致性(rs ≥0.98)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,随着干预措施在高负担登革热环境中规模化,基于产卵器的 监测 为监测沃尔巴克氏体渗入提供了一种资源匮乏、高效且精确的替代方案。这是一个新颖的发现,因为它首次在 WMP 协议的背景下直接比较产卵陷阱和 BG 陷阱数据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更具成本效益和可扩展的 监测 方法提供信息,用于监测登革热多发地区的沃尔巴克氏体渗入,支持 媒介 控制的公共卫生策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象证据,结果基于集群级别的估计。证据强度中等,因为研究结果来自单次试验,可能无法推广到所有情况。

papers.title: Door muggen overdraagbare virussen: een toenemende bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne viruses: an increasing risk for European travelers and public health Mosquito-borne viral infections pose an increasing threat to public health, amplified by globalization and the advance of invasive mosquito species such as Aedes albopictus. International travel exposes travelers to a range of viruses, while endemic areas grapple with significant disease burden and socio-economic consequences. Japanese encephalitis, chikungunya, Zika, and dengue illustrate the diversity of this threat. This article is a narrative review based on the recent literature and epidemiological data. Japanese encephalitis, transmitted by Culex mosquitoes, causes severe neurological complications, particularly in Asia. Chikungunya, spread by Aedes mosquitoes, is characterized by prolonged joint pain. Zika, also transmitted by Aedes, is notorious for congenital abnormalities. Dengue, with 4 serotypes, has a global distribution and can lead to severe hemorrhagic fever. For none of these viral infections is there a specific antiviral treatment; the approach is mainly symptomatic. Climate change and the further spread of invasive mosquito species are expected to lead to an increase in outbreaks, both in frequency and geographical spread. Continuous monitoring, vector control, public education, and vaccination efforts are essential to address this growing threat.

papers.title: Negative Binomial tv-DINGARCH Models for Monthly DHF Cases in Surabaya, Indonesia (2015-2025)
papers.abstract: Count time series data are commonly encountered in epidemiological studies, such as monthly reports of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases. The INGARCH model has been widely used to handle temporal dependence and overdispersion in such data. However, the standard INGARCH model assumes constant dispersion, whereas in practice the dispersion level may vary over time due to epidemiological factors like seasonality or vector control policies. Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. Parameter estimation is conducted using the Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation method implemented in RStudio. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). The likelihood ratio test produces an LR statistic of 47.7560 with a p-value less than 0.000001, strongly rejecting constant dispersion. The stationarity condition is satisfied with \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\). From a public health perspective, these findings indicate that the tv-DINGARCH model better captures the fluctuating dynamics of DHF transmission, supporting more effective surveillance and early warning systems.

papers.title_zh: 印度尼西亚泗水每月 DHF 病例的负二项式 tv-DINGARCH 模型(2015-2025 年)
papers.source_body_en: Count time series data are commonly encountered in epidemiological studies, such as monthly reports of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases. The INGARCH model has been widely used to handle temporal dependence and overdispersion in such data. However, the standard INGARCH model assumes constant dispersion, whereas in practice the dispersion level may vary over time due to epidemiological factors like seasonality or vector control policies. Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. Parameter estimation is conducted using the Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation method implemented in RStudio. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). The likelihood ratio test produces an LR statistic of 47.7560 with a p-value less than 0.000001, strongly rejecting constant dispersion. The stationarity condition is satisfied with \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\). From a public health perspective, these findings indicate that the tv-DINGARCH model better captures the fluctuating dynamics of DHF transmission, supporting more effective surveillance and early warning systems.

papers.title: Technological Innovations in Vector-Borne Disease Control and Their Relationship with Public Health
papers.abstract: Background: Diseases transmitted by vectors remain a major challenge to public health in Indonesia. Continuous use of chemical insecticides has led to resistance, while climate change and vector behavior further exacerbate disease transmission. Therefore, innovative, effective, and sustainable technologies are needed to support community-based vector control efforts. Objective: To review various technological innovations in vector-borne disease control and their relationship with improving public health based on literature from the past five years. Methods: This study is a literature review employing a systematic and narrative approach. The search was conducted through the PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Garuda, and Indonesia OneSearch databases using the keywords “vector control technology innovation” and “public health.” Articles included were publications from 2020–2025 that were relevant to the topic. Results: From the 20 selected articles, five major innovations were identified: the Wolbachia technique, Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) and gene drive, autodissemination using pyriproxyfen, plant-based biolarvicides utilizing local resources, and digital systems based on IoT and GIS. These innovations have been shown to reduce vector density and the incidence of diseases such as dengue and malaria, as well as enhance community participation. Conclusion: Innovative technologies have proven to be more environmentally friendly and efficient compared to conventional methods. Their successful implementation requires policy support, infrastructure readiness, and cross-sector collaboration within the framework of Integrated Vector Management (IVM). Keywords: Technological innovation, vector control, public health, Wolbachia, autodissemination.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on dengue virus and its relationship with public health, specifically examining technological innovations in vector-borne disease control that can improve outcomes for dengue. The central question is whether these innovations are effective and sustainable for community-based vector control efforts.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a literature analysis conducted through PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Garuda, and Indonesia OneSearch databases, using keywords related to vector control technology and public health. It includes articles published from 2020 to 2025 and employs a systematic and narrative approach.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies five major technological innovations in vector control that have been shown to reduce vector density and the incidence of dengue and other related diseases. These include the Wolbachia technique, Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) and gene drive, autodissemination using pyriproxyfen, plant-based biolarvicides, and digital systems based on IoT and GIS. These innovations are considered more environmentally friendly and efficient than conventional methods.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while these innovations show promise, their implementation requires policy support, infrastructure readiness, and cross-sector collaboration. There is a need for further research to address the challenges of scaling these technologies and ensuring their long-term effectiveness in dengue control.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the importance of policy support, infrastructure development, and cross-sector collaboration for the successful implementation of these technologies. It also suggests the need for more studies to evaluate the effectiveness of these innovations in different settings and populations.

While the findings suggest these technologies are more efficient than conventional methods, there are still gaps in understanding their long-term effectiveness and scalability. The implications highlight the importance of further research and cross-sector collaboration to enhance dengue control strategies.

papers.source_body_en: Background: Diseases transmitted by vectors remain a major challenge to public health in Indonesia. Continuous use of chemical insecticides has led to resistance, while climate change and vector behavior further exacerbate disease transmission. Therefore, innovative, effective, and sustainable technologies are needed to support community-based vector control efforts. Objective: To review various technological innovations in vector-borne disease control and their relationship with improving public health based on literature from the past five years. Methods: This study is a literature review employing a systematic and narrative approach. The search was conducted through the PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, Garuda, and Indonesia OneSearch databases using the keywords “vector control technology innovation” and “public health.” Articles included were publications from 2020–2025 that were relevant to the topic. Results: From the 20 selected articles, five major innovations were identified: the Wolbachia technique, Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) and gene drive, autodissemination using pyriproxyfen, plant-based biolarvicides utilizing local resources, and digital systems based on IoT and GIS. These innovations have been shown to reduce vector density and the incidence of diseases such as dengue and malaria, as well as enhance community participation. Conclusion: Innovative technologies have proven to be more environmentally friendly and efficient compared to conventional methods. Their successful implementation requires policy support, infrastructure readiness, and cross-sector collaboration within the framework of Integrated Vector Management (IVM). Keywords: Technological innovation, vector control, public health, Wolbachia, autodissemination.

papers.title: Evaluating Elevated D-Dimer Levels Associated Clinical Conditions in Hospitalised Patients: A Cross-sectional Study
papers.abstract: Introduction: D-dimer is widely used to exclude Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) and to support the diagnosis of Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC). However, Elevated plasma D-dimer levels are not specific to thromboembolic disorders and may be observed in several non-thrombotic conditions such as infections, malignancies, inflammatory disorders, trauma, and postoperative states. This broad range of associated conditions complicates the interpretation of D-dimer results, particularly in resource-limited rural settings where the burden of infectious and inflammatory diseases is relatively high. Aim: To study the clinical conditions associated with elevated plasma D-dimer levels in hospitalised patients. Materials and Methods: The present cross-sectional, retrospective, laboratory database-based study was conducted in the Department of Pathology at a rural tertiary-care medical college in Western Maharashtra, India, from 1st October 2023 to 30th September 2024. Patients were selected from the Laboratory Information System (LIS) database based on records of quantitative plasma D-dimer testing performed during the study period. All consecutive hospitalised patients with at least one D-dimer value greater than 250 μg/L D-dimer Units (DDU), which represents the upper reference limit in the study laboratory, were included in the study. Demographic details, final clinical diagnosis, and selected laboratory parameters including Haemoglobin (Hb), Total Leukocyte Count (TLC), platelet count, Prothrombin Time/International Normalised Ratio (PT/INR), Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (APTT), C-Reactive Protein (CRP), and other available laboratory investigations were retrieved from hospital records. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics. Results: Among 349 D-dimer tests, 247 were >250 μg/L DDU. After excluding duplicate tests (n=6) and cases with insufficient clinical information (n=6), 235 patients were analysed (139 males, 59.1%; 96 females, 40.9%). D-dimer values ranged from 255 to 75,860 μg/L DDU (mean 2,604.3 μg/L). The commonest cause was dengue (133/235, 56.6%), comprising 129 NS1 antigen-positive and 4 IgM-positive cases. Cardiovascular disorders {Myocardial infarction, Atrial Fibrillation, post Coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG)} constituted 28/235 (11.9%), followed by sepsis (16/235, 6.8%) and thromboembolic conditions (12/235, 5.1%). Other causes included Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS), fracture/osteomyelitis, pregnancy-related conditions, malignancy, snakebite and acute febrile illness. Overall mortality was 35/235 (14.9%) and was predominantly seen in patients with moderate-to-severe D-dimer elevation. Conclusion: In the current rural hospital cohort, elevated D-dimer levels were most frequently associated with infectious conditions particularly dengue followed by cardiovascular disorders and sepsis, whereas confirmed thromboembolic events represented a small proportion of cases. Extremely high values were observed in severe systemic illnesses such as sepsis and snakebite and were associated with poorer outcomes. These findings suggest that, in tropical rural settings, elevated D-dimer often reflects infection-related coagulation activation rather than isolated thromboembolism. Clinical interpretation should therefore be guided by the underlying disease context.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项基于实验室数据库的横断面、回顾性研究于 2023 年 10 月 1 日至 2024 年 9 月 30 日在印度西马哈拉施特拉邦的一所农村三级医学院进行。该研究在排除重复测试和临床信息不足的病例后,分析了 235 名至少有一个 D-二聚体值大于 250 μg/L DDU 的住院患者。
elements_zh.methods: 根据定量血浆 D-二聚体检测记录从实验室信息系统中选择患者,并从医院记录中检索人口统计详细信息、最终临床诊断和实验室参数。使用描述性统计分析数据。
elements_zh.main_results: Among the 235 patients, D-dimer values ranged from 255 to 75,860 μg/L DDU with a mean of 2,604.3 μg/L. The most common cause of elevated D-dimer was dengue (133/235, 56.6%), followed by cardiovascular disorders (11.9%), sepsis (6.8%), and thromboembolic conditions (5.1%). Overall mortality was 14.9% and was predominantly seen in patients with moderate-to-severe D-dimer elevation.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在 队列研究 这家乡村医院,D-二聚体水平升高最常与感染性疾病(尤其是登革热)相关,而不是孤立的血栓栓塞。这些发现表明,在热带农村地区,D-二聚体升高通常反映了感染相关的凝血激活。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,D-二聚体结果的临床解释应以潜在疾病背景为指导,特别是在传染病流行的热带农村地区。这种针对具体情况的方法可以提高 D-二聚体检测在此类人群中的诊断效用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素。由于回顾性设计和对数据库记录的依赖,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.source_body_en: Introduction: D-dimer is widely used to exclude Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) and to support the diagnosis of Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC). However, Elevated plasma D-dimer levels are not specific to thromboembolic disorders and may be observed in several non-thrombotic conditions such as infections, malignancies, inflammatory disorders, trauma, and postoperative states. This broad range of associated conditions complicates the interpretation of D-dimer results, particularly in resource-limited rural settings where the burden of infectious and inflammatory diseases is relatively high. Aim: To study the clinical conditions associated with elevated plasma D-dimer levels in hospitalised patients. Materials and Methods: The present cross-sectional, retrospective, laboratory database-based study was conducted in the Department of Pathology at a rural tertiary-care medical college in Western Maharashtra, India, from 1st October 2023 to 30th September 2024. Patients were selected from the Laboratory Information System (LIS) database based on records of quantitative plasma D-dimer testing performed during the study period. All consecutive hospitalised patients with at least one D-dimer value greater than 250 μg/L D-dimer Units (DDU), which represents the upper reference limit in the study laboratory, were included in the study. Demographic details, final clinical diagnosis, and selected laboratory parameters including Haemoglobin (Hb), Total Leukocyte Count (TLC), platelet count, Prothrombin Time/International Normalised Ratio (PT/INR), Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (APTT), C-Reactive Protein (CRP), and other available laboratory investigations were retrieved from hospital records. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics. Results: Among 349 D-dimer tests, 247 were >250 μg/L DDU. After excluding duplicate tests (n=6) and cases with insufficient clinical information (n=6), 235 patients were analysed (139 males, 59.1%; 96 females, 40.9%). D-dimer values ranged from 255 to 75,860 μg/L DDU (mean 2,604.3 μg/L). The commonest cause was dengue (133/235, 56.6%), comprising 129 NS1 antigen-positive and 4 IgM-positive cases. Cardiovascular disorders {Myocardial infarction, Atrial Fibrillation, post Coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG)} constituted 28/235 (11.9%), followed by sepsis (16/235, 6.8%) and thromboembolic conditions (12/235, 5.1%). Other causes included Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS), fracture/osteomyelitis, pregnancy-related conditions, malignancy, snakebite and acute febrile illness. Overall mortality was 35/235 (14.9%) and was predominantly seen in patients with moderate-to-severe D-dimer elevation. Conclusion: In the current rural hospital cohort, elevated D-dimer levels were most frequently associated with infectious conditions particularly dengue followed by cardiovascular disorders and sepsis, whereas confirmed thromboembolic events represented a small proportion of cases. Extremely high values were observed in severe systemic illnesses such as sepsis and snakebite and were associated with poorer outcomes. These findings suggest that, in tropical rural settings, elevated D-dimer often reflects infection-related coagulation activation rather than isolated thromboembolism. Clinical interpretation should therefore be guided by the underlying disease context.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 血浆 D-二聚体水平升高并非血栓栓塞性疾病所特有的,可能在多种非血栓性疾病中观察到,这使得资源有限的农村地区的解释变得复杂。本研究旨在调查住院患者血浆 D-二聚体水平升高相关的临床状况。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项基于实验室数据库的横断面、回顾性研究于 2023 年 10 月 1 日至 2024 年 9 月 30 日在印度西马哈拉施特拉邦的一所农村三级医学院进行。该研究在排除重复测试和临床信息不足的病例后,分析了 235 名至少有一个 D-二聚体值大于 250 μg/L DDU 的住院患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 根据定量血浆 D-二聚体检测记录从实验室信息系统中选择患者,并从医院记录中检索人口统计详细信息、最终临床诊断和实验室参数。使用描述性统计分析数据。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在 队列研究 这家乡村医院,D-二聚体水平升高最常与感染性疾病(尤其是登革热)相关,而不是孤立的血栓栓塞。这些发现表明,在热带农村地区,D-二聚体升高通常反映了感染相关的凝血激活。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,D-二聚体结果的临床解释应以潜在疾病背景为指导,特别是在传染病流行的热带农村地区。这种针对具体情况的方法可以提高 D-二聚体检测在此类人群中的诊断效用。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素。由于回顾性设计和对数据库记录的依赖,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.title: Peptidthioester und Peptidtriazolderivate durch Duale Modifikation von Peptidthiosulfonaten auf dem Harz
papers.abstract: ZUSAMMENFASSUNG Modifizierte Peptide stellen aufgrund ihrer hohen Spezifität und Affinität insbesondere gegenüber pharmakologischen Zielstrukturen, die mit herkömmlichen kleinen Molekülen nicht behandelbar sind, eine wichtige Wirkstoffklasse dar. Daher sind Methoden, die eine effiziente Diversifizierung von Peptiden mit nicht‐kanonischen Modifikationen ermöglichen, sehr gefragt. Eine mögliche Strategie zur Erzeugung diversifizierter Peptide ist die Modifikation im späten Synthesestadium auf dem Harz, bei der eine funktionelle Gruppe – typischerweise in einer Aminosäureseitenkette oder am N‐Terminus – gezielt nach dem Aufbau der Peptidkette modifiziert wird, während die anderen funktionellen Gruppen geschützt bleiben. Hier stellen wir einen Ansatz zur dualen Modifikation im späten Synthesestadium auf dem Harz vor. Dieser Ansatz umfasst eine Reaktionssequenz aus kupferkatalysierter S‐Alkinylierung eines harzgebundenen Peptidthiosulfonats, gefolgt von einer iridiumkatalysierten Azid‐Alkin‐Click‐Reaktion (IrAAC). Auf diese Weise werden Peptide mit komplexen nicht‐kanonischen Modifikationen generiert. Der Ansatz der dualen Modifikation ist hochgradig modular und mit einer breiten Palette von Alkinen für die S‐Alkinylierung sowie von Aziden für die IrAAC kompatibel. Darüber hinaus kann diese Chemie zur Modifikation komplexer Peptide, wie beispielsweise der 34 Aminosäuren umfassenden WW‐Domäne, genutzt werden. In einer Struktur‐Wirkungs‐Beziehungsstudie zu triazolhaltigen Peptid‐Protease‐Inhibitoren des Dengue‐Virus demonstrieren wir das große Potenzial der modularen dualen Modifikation von Peptidthiosulfonaten auf dem Harz zur Modulation von Peptid‐Protein‐Wechselwirkungen.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for efficient diversification of peptides with non-canonical modifications to target pharmacological structures that are not treatable with conventional small molecules.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research presents a novel approach for dual modification of peptides on resin, demonstrated through a structure-activity relationship study with triazole-containing peptide-protease inhibitors targeting the Dengue virus.
analysis.methods: The method involves a reaction sequence of copper-catalyzed S-alkynylation of a resin-bound peptidthiosulfonate, followed by an iridium-catalyzed azide-alkyne click reaction (IrAAC), enabling the generation of peptides with complex non-canonical modifications.
analysis.main_results: The approach successfully generates peptides with complex non-canonical modifications and is highly modular, compatible with a wide range of alkynes and azides, and applicable to complex peptides such as the 34-amino acid WW-domain.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the dual modification strategy as having great potential for modulating peptide-protein interactions, as demonstrated in a study with triazole-containing peptide-protease inhibitors of the Dengue virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of novel peptide-based therapeutics for Dengue virus, potentially enabling the design of more effective inhibitors targeting viral proteases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study is limited to in vitro demonstrations and does not include in vivo validation or clinical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel dual modification approach for peptides on resin, utilizing copper-catalyzed S-alkynylation and iridium-catalyzed azide-alkyne click reactions to generate peptides with complex non-canonical modifications. The method is highly modular and compatible with various alkynes and azides, as demonstrated with a 34-amino acid WW-domain and a structure-activity relationship study of triazole-containing peptide-protease inhibitors targeting the Dengue virus. The findings highlight the potential of this strategy for modulating peptide-protein interactions, offering a promising avenue for developing novel therapeutics against Dengue virus, though further in vivo validation is needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了通过非规范修饰对肽进行有效多样化的需求,以靶向传统小分子无法治疗的药理结构。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究提出了一种在树脂上对肽进行双重修饰的新方法,通过针对 登革病毒 的含三唑肽蛋白酶抑制剂的结构-活性关系研究证明了这一方法。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法涉及树脂结合的肽硫代磺酸盐的铜催化 S-炔基化反应序列,然后是铱催化的叠氮化物-炔点击反应 (IrAAC),从而能够生成具有复杂非规范修饰的肽。
elements_zh.main_results: 该方法成功生成了具有复杂非规范修饰的肽,并且高度模块化,与多种炔烃和叠氮化物兼容,并且适用于复杂肽,例如 34 个氨基酸的 WW 结构域。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将双重修饰策略解释为在调节肽-蛋白质相互作用方面具有巨大潜力,正如对 登革病毒 的含三唑肽-蛋白酶抑制剂的研究所证明的那样。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 登革病毒 新型肽疗法的开发提供了信息,有可能使设计更有效的针对病毒蛋白酶的抑制剂成为可能。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究仅限于体外演示,不包括体内验证或临床数据。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 改性肽由于其高特异性和亲和力,特别是对于常规小分子无法治疗的药理学靶标,构成了一类重要的活性成分。因此,能够实现肽与非典型修饰高效多样化的方法非常受欢迎。生成多样化肽的一种可能策略是在树脂上的合成后期进行修饰,即在构建肽链后,有选择性地修饰一个官能团——通常在氨基酸侧链或N端——而其他官能团保持受保护状态。在此,我们提出了一种在树脂上进行双重合成后期修饰的方法。该方法包括一个反应序列,首先对树脂结合的肽硫代磺酸酯进行铜催化S-炔基化,随后进行铱催化叠氮-炔点击反应(IrAAC)。通过这种方式,生成了具有复杂非典型修饰的肽。这种双重修饰方法具有高度模块化,并与用于S-炔基化的多种炔烃以及用于IrAAC的多种叠氮化物兼容。此外,这种化学方法可用于修饰复杂的肽,例如由34个氨基酸组成的WW结构域。在针对登革病毒含三唑肽蛋白酶抑制剂的结构-活性关系研究中,我们展示了树脂上肽硫代磺酸酯的模块化双重修饰在调节肽-蛋白相互作用方面的巨大潜力。

analysis_zh.main_results: 该方法成功生成了具有复杂非规范修饰的肽,并且高度模块化,与多种炔烃和叠氮化物兼容,并且适用于复杂肽,例如 34 个氨基酸的 WW 结构域。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将双重修饰策略解释为在调节肽-蛋白质相互作用方面具有巨大潜力,正如对 登革病毒 的含三唑肽-蛋白酶抑制剂的研究所证明的那样。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 登革病毒 新型肽疗法的开发提供了信息,有可能使设计更有效的针对病毒蛋白酶的抑制剂成为可能。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究仅限于体外演示,不包括体内验证或临床数据。

Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA Fiji + 16 more Dengue in the Pacific: Multicountry Situation (As of 20 July 2026) Format Situation Report Sources SPCWHO Posted 22 Jul 2026 Originally published 20 Jul 2026 Attachments Download Report (PDF | 727.02 KB) HIGHLIGHTS • Since 1 January 2025, 12 dengue outbreaks have been reported in the Pacific Islands Countries and areas (PICs). • The following PICs reported dengue outbreaks in 2025: American Samoa, Cook Islands, Fiji, French Polynesia, Kiribati, Nauru, Samoa, Tonga and Tuvalu. In 2025 there were 21 258 confirmed cases and 21 deaths reported across the Pacific Dengue fatalities were reported in Fiji (n=8), Samoa (n=7), Tonga (n=3), Nauru (n=2) and Kiribati (n=1). • Between 1 January 2026 and 2 July 2026, a total of 4 447 dengue confirmed cases, 172 hospitalisations and 3 deaths have been reported across the Pacific. • The Pacific Syndromic Surveillance System (PSSS) has reported a total of 8 644 Dengue-like Illness (DLI) cases to date, a lower trend compared to the same period last year. • In 2026 dengue outbreaks were officially declared in New Caledonia, Tonga and Shefa province Vanuatu. • The most affected countries and areas in 2026 include: Cook Islands, French Polynesia, Samoa, and New Caledonia. These account for 94% of confirmed cases. • Dengue serotype-1 (DENV-1) and serotype-2 (DENV-2) are currently in circulation. • Cook Islands declared the end of its outbreak on 25 May 2026. • As of 20 July 2026: o The dengue outbreak remains ongoing in Shefa Province, Vanuatu, with dengue virus serotype 1 (DENV-1) continuing to circulate. o Low levels of transmission are observed in American Samoa, Kiribati, New Caledonia, Samoa, and Tonga. o Wallis and Futuna is under monitoring, as community transmission has recently been reported in both Wallis and Futuna. analysis.brief_en: The Pacific Community (SPC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) released a situation report on 20 July 2026 regarding dengue activity across the Pacific Islands. Since the start of 2025, 12 dengue outbreaks have been reported, resulting in 21,258 confirmed cases and 21 fatalities. In 2026, outbreaks were officially declared in New Caledonia, Tonga, and Shefa province, Vanuatu. Data from January to July 2026 indicates 4,447 confirmed cases, 172 hospitalizations, and 3 deaths. While the Cook Islands has ended its outbreak, transmission continues in Vanuatu, and low levels of transmission persist in several other nations including American Samoa and Samoa. Surveillance systems note a lower overall trend of dengue-like illness compared to the previous year, with DENV-1 and DENV-2 serotypes currently circulating.

news.content_zh: 太平洋共同体 (SPC) 和世界卫生组织 (WHO) 于 2026 年 7 月 20 日发布了一份有关太平洋岛屿登革热活动的情况报告。自2025年初以来,已报告了12起登革热暴发,导致21,258例确诊病例和21人死亡。2026年,新喀里多尼亚、汤加和瓦努阿图谢法省正式宣布暴发。2026年1月至7月的数据显示,确诊病例4,447例,住院治疗172例,死亡3例。虽然库克群岛已经结束了 暴发,但瓦努阿图的 传播 仍在继续,而包括美属萨摩亚和萨摩亚在内的其他几个国家仍然存在低水平的 传播。监测 系统注意到,与前一年相比,登革热样疾病的总体趋势有所下降,目前流行的是 DENV-1 和 DENV-2 血清型。

India Gets Its First Dengue Vaccine As Cases Continue To Rise; Know Availability, Benefits And Key Facts What Is QDENGA? India Gets Its First Dengue Vaccine As Cases Continue To Rise; Know Availability, Benefits And Key Facts QDENGA, also known as TAK-003, is a live, attenuated dengue vaccine designed to protect against all four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4). It is administered as two doses, with the second dose given three months after the first. Sunanda SinghUpdated: Monday, July 20, 2026, 02:03 PM IST What Is QDENGA? | India has taken a major step in the fight against dengue after the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) approved Takeda's QDENGA (TAK-003). The country's first dengue vaccine offers a major step forward in the fight against one of the country's most widespread mosquito-borne diseases. Developed by Japanese pharmaceutical company Takeda, the vaccine has already been approved in several countries and is expected to help reduce the burden of severe dengue infections. Let us know! 👂What type of content would you like to see from us this year?— HubSpot (@HubSpot) What is QDENGA?India has done something significant against dengue and its approval came after India continues to shoulder one of the world's highest dengue burdens, with cases increasing sharply over the past two decades due to urbanisation, climate change, changing mosquito habitats and population growth. But what exactly is QDENGA?QDENGA, also known as TAK-003, is a live, attenuated dengue vaccine designed to protect against all four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4). It is administered as two doses, with the second dose given three months after the first. FPJ Shorts Vijeta Dahiya Claims He Was Fired From CJP, Says 'I Became The Scapegoat' After Defending Abhijeet Dipke | Video Ashok Kharat Confession: ED Alleges Godman Used Followers' KYC To Open Bogus Accounts, Sold ₹100 Tamarind Seeds For ₹1 Lakh Cop On Amarnath Yatra Duty Killed In Anantnag Terror Attack; Massive Crackdown Across South Kashmir Bhojshala Dispute: MP Govt Assures Supreme Court It Will Identify A Site Closer To Complex For Friday Namaz One of its biggest advantages is that it can be given regardless of whether a person has had dengue before, unlike some earlier dengue vaccines that required proof of prior infection. Benefits of the vaccineClinical studies have shown that QDENGA helps reduce the risk of hospitalisation and severe dengue, which can lead to complications such as dengue haemorrhagic fever and dengue shock syndrome. While no vaccine provides 100% protection, it is expected to significantly lower the severity of the disease and reduce pressure on healthcare systems during dengue outbreaks. Unlike the older dengue vaccines, QDENGA does not require people to undergo blood testing to determine whether they had previously dengue.Availability in IndiaThe vaccine has already been approved in more than 40 countries, including the European Union, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Indonesia and Argentina. India now joins that list at a time when dengue is emerging as one of the country's biggest seasonal public health threats.Although the vaccine has received regulatory approval in India, it may not be immediately available across hospitals and clinics. Its commercial launch will depend on manufacturing, supply, pricing and distribution plans. Health authorities are also expected to issue detailed recommendations regarding eligible age groups and vaccination guidelines. Rising temperatures, urbanisation and changing weather patterns have contributed to an increase in mosquito breeding and dengue transmission. Experts believe that vaccination, combined with mosquito control measures, can play a key role in reducing the disease burden. analysis.brief_en: India's drug regulator, the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), has approved QDENGA (TAK-003), the country's first vaccine for dengue. Developed by Takeda, the live attenuated vaccine is designed to protect against all four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4). Administered in two doses three months apart, it offers the advantage of not requiring prior blood testing for dengue infection. The approval comes as India faces a high burden of the disease, with cases rising due to urbanization and climate change. While the vaccine is expected to significantly reduce hospitalizations and severe disease, its immediate availability in clinics will depend on supply and distribution logistics. Health authorities are yet to finalize specific guidelines on eligible age groups.

news.content_title: India approves first dengue vaccine as cases surge in South Asia
news.content: India has approved its first dengue vaccine as cases of the mosquito-borne disease surge in South Asia. Japan's Takeda Pharmaceutical's dengue vaccine QDENGA has been approved by India's drug regulator, the Centre Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO). The global threat posed by dengue has been rising for years, as climate change, urbanisation and international travel aid the spread of the mosquitoes that transmit it. The approval comes as hospitals across South Asia grapple with a surge in dengue infections. Bangladesh is also suffering a major outbreak with over 9,000 cases and 30 deaths that has piled pressure on its health system even as it battles a measles epidemic . Dengue is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected Aedes mosquitoes. Its symptoms include fever, severe muscle pain, and in severe cases, shock and internal bleeding that can be fatal. news.content: Front Page Taiwan News Business Editorial & Opinion Sports World News Features Bilingual Pages SearchSearch All Front Page Taiwan News Business Editorial & Opinion Sports World News Features Bilingual Pages June 23, 2026 - July 22, 2026 GO Home Taiwan News Tue, Jul 21, 2026 page4 New antibody offers possible dengue fever relief By Lee I-chia / Staff reporter Add TT as Preferred Source A research team from the National Health Research Institutes (NHRI) and National Cheng Kung University (NCKU) has identified the mechanism behind the severe inflammatory response triggered by dengue virus infection and developed a bispecific antibody that blocks it, showing promise as a treatment for dengue fever. The research team was led by NCKU Department of Medical Laboratory Science and Biotechnology professor Wang Jen-ren (王貞仁) and NHRI Immunology Research Center Distinguished Investigator Hsieh Shie-liang (謝世良). The team said an estimated 390 million dengue virus infections occur worldwide each year, with about 96 million people developing symptoms and approximately 500,000 progressing to severe disease, resulting in about 22,000 deaths annually. National Health Research Institutes president Sytwu Huey-kang, second from right, poses for a photograph with other experts during a news conference in the Ministry of Health and Welfare in Taipei yesterday. Photo: CNA In 2015, a DENV-2 dengue fever outbreak in Taiwan resulted in 43,000 confirmed cases and 228 deaths, the country’s largest dengue outbreak in decades. NHRI President Sytwu Huey-kang (司徒惠康) said at a news conference yesterday at the Ministry of Health and Welfare that dengue fever remains a public health challenge that is difficult to control. Patients might initially experience only a mild fever, but it is often followed by symptoms such as pain behind the eyes and joint pain, he said. In some cases, the condition can lead to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome. There is no vaccine to effectively prevent dengue fever, and clinical treatment relies mainly on supportive care, Hsieh said. news.content: India’s first dengue vaccine approved: DCGI clears Takeda’s Qdenga for those aged 4 to 60 The two-dose vaccine protects against all four dengue virus strains without requiring pre-vaccination testing, as India battles a rising dengue burden. Written by: Anuradha Mascarenhas 4 min read Pune Updated: Jul 21, 2026 04:51 AM IST The approval comes at a critical time for public health, with reported dengue cases in India increasing 11-fold over the past two decades. (Image generated using AI) The Drug Controller General of India (DCGI) has approved Japanese company Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India’s dengue vaccine, Qdenga, making it the first such vaccine to be greenlighted in India. It is designed to protect against all four dengue virus strains (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4) and can be administered regardless of prior dengue exposure. It does not require pre-vaccination testing, the company said. The vaccine is administered subcutaneously. It comes as a two-dose regimen of 0.5 mL each, with doses given three months apart. The price has not been announced yet but since Takeda has entered into a manufacturing partnership with Hyderabad -based Biological E to produce up to 50 million doses annually, costs are expected to be competitive for the Indian market. Pricing will also depend on whether this gets incorporated into government immunisation programmes later. Also Read | Dengue is spreading fast: Can cutting-edge science outsmart it at last? The approval comes at a critical time for public health, with reported dengue cases in India increasing 11-fold over the past two decades. India continues to account for nearly one-third of the global dengue burden. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease that poses a significant global public health threat, with prevalence in over 125 countries. India accounts for nearly one-third of the global dengue burden. In an official statement issued today, Dr Mahender Nayak, head of Intercontinental Markets, Takeda, said, “Dengue is a growing public health challenge and India needs sustained, evidence-based prevention.” The latest seven-year data for Qdenga show continued protection against dengue infection and hospitalisation across all four serotypes — an important milestone for communities and health systems.” Since its launch in 2022, Qdenga has been approved in 43 countries, with more than 32 million doses distributed globally. Dr Goh Choo Beng, Medical Affairs Head, Southeast Asia and India Cluster, said, “India carries a substantial dengue burden, and all four dengue virus serotypes have been documented as co-circulating in several regions. The approval represents an important step in strengthening India’s comprehensive approach to dengue prevention, alongside vector control, surveillance, community awareness and other public health measures.” Also Read | Serum Institute of India ties up with DNDi for Phase III trial of dengue therapy What is the vaccine about? It is designed to protect against all four dengue virus serotypes. It is approved for use in the four to 60 year age group, regardless of previous dengue exposure, without the need for pre-vaccination testing.It is the most extensively studied dengue vaccine, with long-term clinical data demonstrating sustained protection against dengue disease and dengue-related hospitalisation. Story continues below. Subscribe to see fewer ads. What did clinical trials show? The approval in India is based on results from Takeda’s global clinical development programme, involving 19 Phase 1, 2 and 3 clinical trials with over 28,000 participants in both endemic and non-endemic regions. This included the pivotal Phase III TIDES (DEN-301) trial, which evaluated the vaccine in over 20,000 participants across eight countries over an extended period to evaluate both the long-term safety and efficacy of QDENGA. At 12 months following the second dose, the study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating an overall vaccine efficacy of 80.2% against virologically confirmed dengue (VCD). At 18 months, the study also demonstrated 90.4% efficacy against dengue-related hospitalisation, meeting a key secondary endpoint of the study. After 4.5 years, two doses of QDENGA provided 84.1% vaccine efficacy in preventing dengue-related hospitalisations. Notably, the vaccine has also shown sustained safety and efficacy for up to seven years across all four dengue virus serotypes. This approval is also supported by data from a Phase III clinical trial (DEN-302) conducted in Indian participants, which evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of the vaccine in the 4–60 age group. The study demonstrated that QDENGA was found to be tolerated, safe and immunogenic in healthy adults, adolescents and children. These clinical outcomes are further supported by real-world evidence generation and ongoing pharmacovigilance to deepen understanding of the vaccine’s safety and impact. WHO nod The vaccine has also received WHO prequalification, confirming it meets global standards for quality, safety and efficacy, and enabling eligibility for procurement through international agencies such as UNICEF and PAHO to support wider access. The two-dose regimen protects against all four dengue virus serotypes and does not require pre-vaccination testing. The approval is supported by clinical trials involving over 28,000 participants, showing 80.2% efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue and high protection against hospitalization. This development comes as India faces a significant dengue burden, with reported cases rising 11-fold in two decades and the country accounting for nearly one-third of global cases. Manufacturing partner Biological E will produce up to 50 million doses annually, though pricing remains undisclosed.

Opens in new tabWion/India/DCGI clears Takeda's QDENGA, India's first-ever dengue vaccine: Full details insideDCGI clears Takeda's QDENGA, India's first-ever dengue vaccine: Full details insideEdited By Vinay Prasad SharmaPublished: Jul 20, 2026, 22:03 IST | Updated: Jul 20, 2026, 22:03 ISTRepresentative image. Photograph: (Magnific)Story highlightsThe vaccine offers protection against all four strains of the dengue virus and is approved for people aged four to 60, irrespective of whether they've had dengue before, meaning no prior testing is required before vaccination.The Drug Controller General of India (DCGI) has approved Japanese company Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India’s dengue vaccine, QDENGA. It is the first such vaccine that India has greenlighted. The approved vaccine is designed to protect against all four dengue virus strains (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4) and can be administered despite prior dengue exposure. The company confirmed that the vaccine does not require pre-vaccination testing.The vaccine is given as an under-the-skin (subcutaneous) injection, administered in a two-dose regimen of 0.5 mL each, which is spaced three months apart. While pricing has not been finalised yet, but are expected to be affordable for Indians, given that Takeda has partnered with Hyderabad-based Biological E to produce up to 50 million doses annually. The final price will also hinge on whether the vaccine is eventually included in government-run immunisation schemes.The vaccine offers protection against all four strains of the dengue virus and is approved for people aged four to 60, irrespective of whether they've had dengue before, meaning no prior testing is required before vaccination.
